npcs.name: Black Belt2
says: I put my Vs. Seeker through its paces a lot. I battled this one intriguing Trainer over and over using it. She asked me, “Do you like me?” Like, oops! Hahahahah!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: The item Revive is something I could use now. But I’ve only got two Gym Badges, so I can’t buy any yet...

npcs.name: Beauty
says: Do you know Amity Square? It’s a happy and cheerful place. You can find Accessories there you can’t buy in Poké Marts.

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: Well, now, you’re a Trainer? That makes you both papa and mama to your Pokémon. You know how having Pokémon around leads to new discoveries? It’s the same for parents and kids. I’m always learning from my kids.

npcs.name: Baby In Pram
says: Kuufu fuu!

npcs.name: Pikachu
says: PIKACHU: Pikapii?

npcs.name: Battle Girl
says: Babies and Pokémon get along perfectly together. When babies take naps, Pokémon go to sleep right next to them.

npcs.name: Ninja Boy
says: When I get bigger, I’m going to be a Trainer, too!

npcs.name: Twin
says: When I grow up, I want to become a Pokémon coordinator.

npcs.name: Lass
says: Oh, wow, you’re a Pokémon Trainer. Having lots of Pokémon around is a lot of responsibility. But that also comes with a lot of fun!

npcs.name: School Kid M
says: ...My sisters make so much noise, no one even notices me.

npcs.name: Expert M
says: Some act kindly in hopes of being treated kindly in turn. But, how could that be a bad thing?

npcs.name: Expert F
says: Hearthome is a kid-friendly city, they say, but I disagree. Hearthome is friendly to kids, grown-ups, and Pokémon too.

npcs.name: Old Man
says: All my grandchildren are clamoring for Pokémon of their own. It may be tricky to manage it, but it will brighten up the mood more.

npcs.name: Old Woman
says: Oh, no, there are no stairs in this house. It’s easier that way. The lack of stairs makes it easy for the little Pokémon to get about.

npcs.name: Bebe
says: Hiya! Oh, you’re a Trainer! That means you’re using Pokémon Boxes! I love meeting end users! Oh, what’s up? Why that astonished look? Oh, right, sorry! There I go running my mouth again! My name’s Bebe! You know the PC Pokémon Boxes? I’m the system administrator! I know this is out of the blue, but do you want a Pokémon named EEVEE?
Bebe: My buddy Bill developed the basic Pokémon Box storage system. I tinkered with it here and there to make it easier to use.
Bebe: So, how about it? Do you want that Pokémon EEVEE?

Bebe: Oh? Now that’s a National Pokédex I’m seeing. Good for you! You’ll be using my Pokémon Boxes a whole lot more if you’ve got that. Well, I always thought a good Trainer ought to juggle Boxes smartly, though. I shouldn’t be the one to say so.

Bebe: Here you go! That EEVEE, I got it from a good friend in Johto who has a whole lot of them. Who knows how many EEVEE he’s raised over the years. Sorry, that doesn’t mean anything to you. Please, be good to it!
[name] accepted the EEVEE!
Would you like to give a nickname to the EEVEE that Bebe gave you?
Bebe: Oh, OK... Guess I’ll have to raise it myself.
Bebe: Here you go! Wait, I can’t do that! You can’t take any more Pokémon with you! Right about now, my Pokémon Boxes come in handy!

npcs.name: Youngster
says: Have you checked out the Global Terminal in Jubilife City? It uses Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection! I can’t explain it, but it’s wicked!

npcs.name: Socialite
says: Hello, do you have a Poffin Case? If you haven’t got one, you really must visit the Pokémon Fan Club.

npcs.name: Guitarist
says: Fantina, the Gym Leader, likes Contests, too. That lady has a huge appetite for experiencing everything in life!

npcs.name: Middle Aged Man
says: There are the Contests! Then, we have Amity Square! Hearthome gets visitors from all over, so things have to be nice and clean!

npcs.name: Lady
says: People all over the world follow Pokémon Contests. What should I do? I could captivate the whole world!

npcs.name: Shroomish
says: SHROOMISH: Pofwaaah!

npcs.name: Twin
says: My SHROOMISH finds Berries and things when we go to Amity Square.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: I have something for your Pokémon to hold. Take this [name].
The [name] should be held by a Pokémon in battles. The holder regains HP a little every time it inflicts damage. That was given to me when I was on vacation, but I already had one.

npcs.name: Clefairy
says: CLEFAIRY: Pippi!

items.where: Hearthome City Dp Gym Leader Room: given by Fantina
items.sub: Hearthome City Dp Gym Leader Room

items.where: Hearthome City Gym Leader Room: given by Fantina

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: A Pokémon fed Poffins does better in Visual Evaluations. I’d better learn how to cook delicious Poffins at the Poffin House!

npcs.name: Clown
says: A Contest has three parts: Visual! Dance! And Acting! The Contestants get graded in those categories, dohoho!

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: They put up photos of the winners!

npcs.name: Rich Boy
says: You’re going to enter Contests? And, yup, you have a Poffin Case. Let me gift you with this fabulously wonderful Poffin!

Feed that Poffin to a Pokémon you’re going to enter in Contests. Oh, and a word of advice. Go take a run at the Contests! The best way to get ready is to get some practice first. You can take practice sessions at the counter on the right.

Feed that Poffin to a Pokémon you’re going to enter in Contests. Oh, and a word of advice for you. Go take a run at the Contests! However, the best way to get ready is to get some practice first. You can take practice sessions at the counter on the right.

You’re going to enter Contests? But I don’t see a Poffin Case. It could be tough for you to win Contests without it. But if you’re determined to enter, don’t let me stop you. It wouldn’t hurt to get in some practice at the counter on the right.

Oh, no. Your Poffin Case is full. I’ll give it to you another time. Oh, and a word of advice. Go take a run at the Contests! ...That isn’t much of a strategy. You might want some practice first. You can take practice sessions at the counter on the right.
[name] received a Mild Poffin!
The Mild Poffin was put away in the Poffin Case.
Like everything else, the basics are important. It takes practice to win Contests!
Oh, no. Your Poffin Case’s full.

npcs.name: Fantina
says: Yes? I beg your pardon? Ah, oui, Contests you are here for? I hope very much you enjoy them. Incidentally, Fantina, the Gym Leader of Hearthome, is also a Contestant. She is, how do you say, très fantastique! Fantina being myself, of course! Mmm, let me see... You also seem to be très strong. Enfin, so it shall be. I wait for you at the Gym!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: For the Visual judging, you want to dress up your Pokémon nicely with Accessories matched to the theme. That means you’ll be at an advantage if you have lots of Accessories.

npcs.name: Idol
says: For the Dance competition, your Pokémon needs to perfectly mimic the dance steps of the lead dancer.

npcs.name: Beauty
says: For the performance aspect of Contests, Pokémon need the right kinds of moves. But what’s even more important is your choice of the Judge. If everyone performs for the same Judge, your Pokémon leaves less of an impression on that Judge.

npcs.name: Black Belt
says: At the Cool Contest you gotta pull off a cool move! Gets the Judges all excited! If the Judge’s excitement peaks, you score massive bonus points! So hot!

npcs.name: Fantina
npcs.sub: Hearthome City Dp Gym Leader Room

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: Hey, there! How’s it going, Champ-to-be? You must really like hearing me talk. If you want to hear my long spiel again, just say, “Yes!”
Oh! [name]! You’ve beaten the Gym Leader! There seems to be no end to how tough you are getting! At least that’s how I see it! ...You do realize I say that to everyone, right?

Hey, there! Hello, Champ-to-be! Let me tell you how this Gym is wicked! I’ll tell you! First, it’s pitch-black! Also, there are the usual Gym Trainers. They have flashlights, too. If you cast a light on one, or they catch you in the light, the battle’s on! OK, now this is really important! It’s about the tiles on the floor. First, find the one blue tile in the room, and memorize the mark on it. Next, head for the red door with the same mark on it. Advance through the correct red doors to reach the Gym Leader. If you choose a wrong red door, you get sent back here, though. Oops! How silly of me! I forgot to tell you something vital! The Gym Leader here is a user of Ghost-type Pokémon. Beware, Normal-type moves have no effect at all on ghosts! It’s as if they weren’t there! But you’ll have to see for yourself. Go get ’em, challenger! I believe in you!
OK, go get ’em!

npcs.name: Fantina
says: Ohohoho!! Finally, you have arrived! Since I came to this country, always I try to learn new things. They hold Contests in this city? I say to myself, enfin, I will excel. That is why I dress this way. C’est une performance! Also, I study Pokémon very much. I have come to be Gym Leader. And, uh, so it shall be that you challenge me. But I shall win. That is what a Gym Leader does, non?
I am dumbfounded! So very, very strong! You, your Pokémon, so strong! Your power is admirable! I shall honor it with this Gym Badge!
[name] received the Relic Badge from Fantina!
That Badge will let you use the hidden move Defog outside of battle. Also, you can make use of this Technical Machine. That is what I think.
Three Gym Badges... But you must not forget this. There are many other Trainers. Strong Trainers, too. There are many more in Sinnoh. Have patience! You must become stronger, one at a time.

npcs.name: Sailor
says: Do you want to sail somewhere?
Aye, aye! Anchors aweigh!
You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!

npcs.name: Riley
says: ...You are? OK, you’re [name]. I’m Riley. I’m a Trainer, and yes, it is a bit odd that I would be training here. Anyway, it’s always nice to meet another Trainer. Here’s a gift.
Riley: That Hidden Machine contains the move Strength. To use it out of battle, you need the Mine Badge from Canalave Gym. I’ll be training inside. You can join me if you’d like.

Riley: That Hidden Machine contains the move Strength. To use it out of battle, you need the Badge from Canalave Gym... Oh, never mind, you’ve already got the Mine Badge. My bad. I’ll be training inside. You can join me if you’d like.

npcs.name: Riley
says: Riley: Haha, I’d have to agree. People training here would be those with too much time on their hands.
Riley: Spending time with you was very enjoyable. I intend to test my skills in other places from now on. Let’s meet again! Take care on the way out.
Riley: What’s going on here, though? The native Pokémon are restless... I don’t like this... Let’s hurry.

Riley: Imagine what it would be like for a Steel-type Pokémon user to battle a Steel type. Would that be like battling yourself, I wonder? I mean, it’s a lot harder to defeat one’s self than anyone else.
Riley: Have you met Byron? The Leader of Canalave Gym? He’s asked me to become a Gym Leader, but there’s his son Roark to consider.
Riley: This used to be a fairly thriving ore mine once upon a time. I guess the steel ore’s played out. There’s only Pokémon here now.
Riley: Thanks. You really helped me out. Listen, I have a Pokémon Egg here. Would you take it with you?
Riley: Thanks! I’d like you to show the Pokémon that’s inside the Egg all sorts of new places.
Riley: I hope you’ll accept it as a token of our friendship.
Riley: Thank you... But you don’t have room to take another Pokémon. All right, then. I’ll wait here for you.

npcs.name: Coord Event Grunts
says: Riley: I get it now. You’re responsible for agitating the Pokémon. I don’t care what good reason you may have, but I don’t want you bringing any trouble into the mine.
Grunt 1: We’re Team Galactic! We’ll take all the Pokémon we want! Isn’t that right, partner?
Grunt 2: You said it, brother! So that’s what we’re gonna do! We’re abducting all the Pokémon from this rusted-out Iron Island!

Riley: To share in all the joys and all the sorrows... That is how all the Trainers and Pokémon live in Sinnoh! I won’t allow anyone to defy that code of ethics! Come on, [name]! This is one battle we can’t lose!

npcs.name: Byron
says: Byron: Hm? You’re in training, then? You know, my son trains as hard as you do. But I still treat him as if he were a child. It’s ridiculous, really. He is a proper Gym Leader and all. It’s always tricky between a father and son, it seems. Humph, I’ve wasted your time. Take this as my apology!
There are Pokémon that evolve into the Steel type using that Metal Coat. They need to hold that item while being traded to evolve. Try using it if you’d like. Farewell!

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: When you walk with your Pokémon, they gradually grow friendlier.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M1
says: Hiya, where’d you come from? ... Twinleaf Town, huh... It’s a nice place. Quiet and all. Jubilife City is a big place, so it might be a bit of a shock to you.

npcs.name: School Kid M1
says: The way you look... You’re obviously a Trainer! Can you tell me what type of Pokémon you like?
You chose the Grass type? No wonder you look so calm. I think you need to watch out you don’t get burned by fire.
The Fire type? You must have a fiery personality. You’d better watch out that fire isn’t doused by water, though.
A person that likes the Water type must be somewhat cool. But beware of being drained dry by thirsty grass.

npcs.name: Twin
says: Did you see me on TV? I was in an interview!

npcs.name: Expert M1
says: Hello, Trainer! Do you know much about Pokémon?
Ah, I see! You are knowledgeable! I imagine you wouldn’t see the need to visit the Trainers’ School, then. But do visit if you have the time. You may discover something new!
Oh, you’re not knowledgeable... But not to worry! There’s the Trainers’ School. The school will teach you the basics of Pokémon.

npcs.name: School Kid M2
says: OK, set six Poké Balls in my belt... Yeah, that’ll do it. At most, you can have six Pokémon with you.

npcs.name: Expert M2
says: Jubilife City’s built on land they carved out of a mountain. The people and Pokémon of Oreburgh City helped out with that undertaking.

Hello! Let me ask you, have you paid a visit to the TV station? If you’ve never been, you owe it to yourself to make the trip. And, if you’ve been there before, it never hurts to visit again. After all, you can be a star! Or at least dream of being one!

npcs.name: Poketch Co President
says: The three clowns will each ask you a skill-testing question. The questions will all have to do with Pokémon. After all, a Pokétch is a tool for Pokémon Trainers. Collect a Coupon from each clown, then come see me, OK?
OK, let me count your Coupons! I’ll use the Pokétch here... One, two, three! Bravo! I say, bravo! In return for these Coupons, I present you this Pokémon Watch, or Pokétch for short!
[name] received a Pokétch!
You can add apps to your Pokétch to make it even more versatile! Touch the Pokétch screen and find the apps that are right for you!

npcs.name: Clown1
says: Hi! I’m a Pokétch campaign clown! Let’s roll out my question! Does a Pokémon grow by defeating others and gaining Exp. Points?
Pokémon grow stronger through battling. Some Pokémon even grow into an entirely different form in a process known as evolution.
Ding-ding! You’re absolutely correct!
Pokémon grow stronger by defeating other Pokémon in battle. Some Pokémon even grow into an entirely different form in a process known as evolution.
Here you go! Your Pokétch Coupon!
Bzzzzt! That’s the wrong answer...

npcs.name: Clown2
says: Hi! I’m a Pokétch campaign clown! Let’s roll out my question! Just like Pokémon types, the moves of Pokémon also have types?
If the Pokémon’s type matches its move’s type, that move is made much more powerful!
Ding-ding! You’re absolutely correct!
Here you go! Your Pokétch Coupon!
Bzzzzt! That’s the wrong answer...

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M3
says: Past here is the Global Terminal. It lets you trade with the whole world! Trading Pokémon means connecting with friends, both old and new. That’s awesome!

npcs.name: Clown3
says: Hi! I’m a Pokétch campaign clown! Let’s roll out my question! Can a Pokémon hold an item?
Hi, there. You should stick around. We’re doing a Pokétch campaign soon. Before it starts, I think you should brush up at the Trainers’ School.
A Pokémon may hold a single item. Some items become effective as soon as they are held by Pokémon. Berries are eaten by Pokémon as necessary during battle.
Ding-ding! You’re absolutely correct!
A Pokémon may hold a single item. Some items become effective as soon as they are held by a Pokémon. Berries are eaten by Pokémon as necessary during battle.
Here you go! Your Pokétch Coupon!
Bzzzzt! That’s the wrong answer...

npcs.name: Kid With NDS1
says: I’m trading Pokémon with my buddy!

npcs.name: Kid With NDS2
says: I made my Pokémon hold an item before trading it. That will make the other Trainer double happy!

npcs.name: Looker
says: Ah, it is you! Have no fear. There are no shady characters about. Incidentally, have you not obtained a Gym Badge? I believe you receive one for defeating the Gym Leader at a Pokémon Gym?
Ah, it is you! Have no fear. There are no shady characters about. Incidentally, have you visited the Trainers’ School? Did your friend not guide you there earlier?
Ah, it is you! Have no fear. There are no shady characters about. Incidentally, have you not obtained a Pokétch? I believe a Pokétch is now free in exchange for some Coupons?

npcs.name: Expert F
says: Oh, hello, darlings. Isn’t my Pokétch quite fetching? It’s the latest design that just came out. I obtained it instantly, of course. A Trainer would be simply lost without a Pokétch, after all.

npcs.name: Pachirisu
says: PACHIRISU: Pachipachii?

npcs.name: Pikachu
says: PIKACHU: Piika pi!

npcs.name: Beauty
says: Oh, your Pokémon is quite adorable! Here, try making it hold this [name].

A Pokémon holding that Quick Claw can sometimes attack first, even if it is normally a little bit slow. There are other items that are only useful when given to a Pokémon. Try finding other items that you can make your Pokémon hold. ...I sound like I’m a teacher or something.

npcs.name: Bug Catcher
says: I like how Pokémon can use attacks. That makes things fun and different. Sometimes, when they get stronger, Pokémon learn new moves. That keeps things fresh and fun when using moves.

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder M
says: Did you buy some Heal Balls at the Poké Mart? A Heal Ball completely heals the Pokémon it captures on the spot. That means you can catch a Pokémon and have it battle-ready right away. Of course, if your team has six Pokémon in it, it won’t do any good.

npcs.name: Guitarist
says: Aww, man. I wasted money on some Poké Balls. I should’ve lowered the HP of wild Pokémon more before throwing them.

npcs.name: Pokefan
says: The one thing you must remember is to pack some Potions. If all your Pokémon faint, it’ll be lights out for you, too!

npcs.name: Beauty
says: Potions are important, but sometimes, it’s better to simply avoid battles. If you want to avoid wild Pokémon for a while, just use a Repel. After all, if you don’t battle, your Pokémon can’t lose HP.

npcs.name: Trainer F
says: You can still catch a Pokémon if you already have six traveling with you. It automatically gets sent to the PC network in Pokémon Centers. Knowing that, I can keep on catching more and more Pokémon! It’ll make it more fun to check the PC in any Pokémon Center!

npcs.name: School Kid M
says: In the Union Room upstairs, you can chat and trade with other people. And that’s not all you can do. Check it out!

npcs.name: Twin
says: You know how Pokémon have types like Water, Fire, and Grass? Well, all types have strengths and weaknesses against other types.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: I got my PIKACHU through a trade from someone somewhere in the world. It grows quickly, so its level goes up quickly, too. But it doesn’t always listen to me... That’s because I only have one Gym Badge. We don’t always have an easy time, but it’s still my irreplaceable partner!

npcs.name: Pikachu
says: PIKACHU: Pikapikapikaaah!

npcs.name: Middle Aged Man
says: If everyone around the world had Pokémon... Then everyone around the world could communicate!

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M
says: Wi: We come from faraway land. I come see the Pokémon I trade. I worry if it growing properly.

npcs.name: Beauty
says: Fi: I like look at Pokémon I get from friend in trade. It make me remember my friend!

npcs.name: Collector
says: You can trade Pokémon with people around the world on Nintendo WFC... Just hearing that gets my heart racing. Such exciting times!

npcs.name: Lass
says: When you connect with people on Nintendo WFC, it’s hard to tell if the world’s big or small.

npcs.name: Beauty
says: They keep track of official records here. Things like winning streaks, or how many Pokémon you’ve caught. You can check everyone’s records up on the third floor.

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: Why don’t you try dressing up your Pokémon now? We have a Fitting Room on the second floor. Dress up your Pokémon nicely with Accessories!

npcs.name: Middle Aged Man
says: I’m going to get commercials shown on TV. They’ll attract more customers to the department store.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer Snow F
says: This is the Pokémon Lottery Corner. I’m Felicity, your attendant today. If your drawn number matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon, you could win fabulous gifts. Would you like to check today’s lucky number?
[name]? Yes, I’ve been expecting you. This is the prize we’ve been holding for you. Here you go!
You’ve already drawn a Loto Ticket today. Please come back tomorrow.
This is the Pokémon Lottery Corner. Would you like to check today’s lucky number again?
First, I’ll look up today’s Pokémon Lottery Corner lucky number. ...
Your Loto Ticket number is [name]. Now, let’s see if it matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon.
Oh. I see. Please do visit us again.
I’m sorry. You didn’t get a match...
Congratulations! The ID No. of your team’s [name] matches your Loto Ticket number!
Congratulations! The ID No. of your PC-boxed [name] matches your Loto Ticket number!
The last digit matched, so you win the fourth prize!
The last two digits matched, so you win the third prize!
The last three digits matched, so you win the second prize!
The last four digits matched, so you win the first prize!
Oh, my goodness, all five digits matched! You’ve won the jackpot prize! This is just so incredible! ...Oh, I’m sorry! Your prize! I got carried away there. Here you go!
Please do visit again! Good-bye from Felicity, your attendant!

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M
says: The TV station interviews all sorts of Trainers for its shows. After all, people want to know about good Trainers and what they say. Personally, I’d like to learn more about Gym Leaders. I’d also like to hear about the tough Elite Four of the Pokémon League.

npcs.name: Idol
says: I don’t know what to do. What Accessories will go well with my dress today?

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: The star of tomorrow is... You! Your Pokémon has a glow about it! So, a gift for our future star!
That’s a [name]! I hope you get into collecting Accessories for your Pokémon!

npcs.name: Roughneck
says: The room at the back is our dreamy fitting room. Once you’re done in there, get our dreamy Hiker to take a dreamy photo!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: Ooh, your Pokémon are so very charming! How enchanting! They’re so charming I will even hang a picture of one right beside me! I’m only doing this especially for you! Exciting, don’t you think? Dress up your Pokémon in my boudoir and make it a sight to behold! I will snap a photo when you’re done. You will do this, won’t you?
If you dress up any Pokémon again, the photo here will be changed. Would you like to dress up a Pokémon, dearie?
Ooh, ooh, yes! How nice! Let’s not delay! Should I explain to you how to dress up your Pokémon?
Oh, you silly thing... Where’s your sense of adventure?

You have a Fashion Case, don’t you? Ah, oui, wonderful! Just choose the Accessories and put them on your Pokémon. When you’re done, I will snap a photo and put it up beside me! If you mix your records with others, you can get their photos, too! I think it will be much easier if you will just try!
Ooh, I wonder which Pokémon you’ll dress up?
Teheheh... I hope you will dress it up adorably!
Ooh, non, non, non! That’s an Egg! It’s too young to be dressing up!
Ooh, nice work! Let’s display the photo right away! Oh, but it needs to have a title!
Oh... You came out without doing anything... How disappointing.
[name]... Ooh, yes, yes! I get it now! Your aesthetics shine through!
I put your photo up right here. It just looks so perfect there!
Oh, non, non, non! It will be forlorn without a title.

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder M
says: They display photos from Trainers you been mixin’ records with, right? I hope you collect yerself some good photos of dressed-up Pokémon!

npcs.name: Twin
says: Someone gave me a new Backdrop when I went to the Global Terminal.

npcs.name: Beauty1
says: The room closest to the stairs is the Group Ranking Room.
The room on the opposite side is the Global Ranking Room.

npcs.name: Beauty2
says: I just realized something awesome! I should be trading Pokémon more! The more trades I make, the better my odds of winning the Pokémon Lottery! Why? Because the ID No. of a Pokémon is different from Trainer to Trainer!

npcs.name: Gym Guide1
says: Records are fine things. They tell you the history of stuff. You can really sense the dramatic stories behind all those numbers!

npcs.name: Gym Guide2
says: Hey, there! How’s it going? I’m a TV producer here. Are you watching TV? So, let me ask you. Will you tell me your opinion on TV?
Oh, yeah? That’s interesting. Moving right along, what feedback can you give me about TV?
Oh, all right. I can understand how busy it must get for you. It’d be cool if you could answer my questions when you’ve got time. See you again!

...Oh? The fact that you know that phrase tells me you’re someone in the know. You’re a Trainer, right? I’ll pull some strings for you. I think I can swing a deal to get you a new wallpaper for your PC Boxes. Make sure you keep your channel tuned to Jubilife TV.
Oh, yeah? That’s interesting. Thanks for answering my questions. I’ll file it away for reference. Keep your channel tuned to Jubilife TV!

...Oh? The fact that you know that phrase tells me you’re someone in the know. You’re a Trainer, right? I’ll pull some strings for you. I think I can swing a deal so you can receive a Mystery Gift. Make sure you keep your channel tuned to Jubilife TV.

npcs.name: Fisherman
says: I really don’t win many battles... But it doesn’t get me down. I’m trying for the world record at Pokémon fishing!

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: Someone broke my Pokémon-catching record! I’ll reclaim my record and regain my place in the standings!

npcs.name: Collector
says: I bet it’d feel great if I could be number one here! Maybe I’ll enter some Contests with my partner.

npcs.name: Worker
says: Sorry, I’m still fine-tuning this thingy here.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: You can see the rankings of people in your group here. It makes me try even harder ’cause I can’t stand losing to my friends!

npcs.name: Battle Girl
says: These rankings are nifty! I’m going to make a group and compete with all my best friends!

npcs.name: Worker
says: Sorry, I’m still fine-tuning this thingy here.

npcs.name: Middle Aged Man
says: Your exploits are fantastic! With our TV station, we can tell the whole world about you! It’s merely one of many possibilities! Harrumph!

npcs.name: Receptionist
says: “Participation for all” is our TV network’s motto.

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder F
says: We’re promoting the theme “Smiles are dreamy.” In keeping with that theme, we added variety programs to our scheduling. Please do tune in!

npcs.name: Receptionist
says: Hello, thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to visit us. To which floor may I take you?
I look forward to serving you again.
Sorry, we are already on that floor.
Certainly. Elevator going up.
Certainly. Elevator going down.
Here we are!

npcs.name: Saturn
says: The mission is proceeding without a hitch. The boss should be pleased. Everything is for everyone, and for the good of Team Galactic!

I recognize your face! You’re the child who raided the Team Galactic building in Eterna! Humph! Jupiter should be ashamed of herself, being beaten by a child. But anything and anyone that opposes Team Galactic must be crushed! Even the very thought of opposition will not be tolerated!

Gah! Even I, a Commander, only managed to buy us time? But that’s fine. A child like you will never be able to stem the flow of time! Team Galactic will get the three legendary Pokémon of the lakes! With their power, we will create an entirely new universe! By now, Mars should have captured the Pokémon of Lake Verity...

npcs.name: Prof Rowan
says: Rowan: How dare you! You misguided thugs!
Rowan: [name], I need you to go to Lake Acuity right away. I’m worried about [name].
[name]! Dawn needs your help!
[name]! Lucas needs your help!

npcs.name: Counterpart
says: Dawn: [name]! It’s T-Team Galactic! They’re taking the Pokémon of the lake... I... I couldn’t beat this person...
Lucas: It’s Team Galactic! They took the Pokémon of the lake... This woman... I lost to her, but just barely!
Dawn: [name], what is Team Galactic up to? Are the abducted Pokémon of the lakes going to be OK?
Lucas: [name], what’s Team Galactic up to? They’d better not harm the Pokémon they took from the lakes...

npcs.name: Mars
says: Mars: That face...! It brings back bad memories! I’m talking about the windworks! I caught a whole lot of trouble for that little incident. What’s with that look on your face? You do remember me, don’t you? Fine, whatever. I’ll tell you who I am again! I’m Mars, one of Team Galactic’s Commanders. So, what is it? Are you some lovey-dovey couple to the rescue? Not a chance! Not even a teeny one! You’re all going down!

I lost again... So, first the windworks, and now Lake Verity that I owe you for! This shouldn’t be happening to Team Galactic’s Commander... ...Calm down, Mars... I’ve done my part in all of this... My mission was to transport the lake’s Pokémon to our HQ... ...That’s right! I accomplished my mission without a problem!
Team! We’re pulling out! The boss is waiting at the HQ!

The Pokémon of the three lakes are connected somehow. Thanks to Saturn’s grandstanding at Lake Valor, a cavern appeared here. It was the cavern where the Pokémon MESPRIT slept. MESPRIT appeared, too, probably to go help its friends. That worked out well for us. It was super easy to catch. So, now we’ve got them all: MESPRIT, “The Being of Emotion.” AZELF, “The Being of Willpower.” UXIE, “The Being of Intelligence.” Now that we have them all... You can look forward to what plans Team Galactic has for them!

Rowan: I see... This also occurred at Lake Valor... Another legendary Pokémon was taken away by Team Galactic... Both of you went up against full-fledged criminals... The fact that you’re unharmed is reason enough to celebrate. ...But what about [name]? What is happening at Lake Acuity? Is [name] safe?

npcs.name: Grunt M
says: Ow! Ouch! What’s with this old-timer?

npcs.name: Prof Rowan
says: Rowan: Hmmm... No legendary Pokémon, nothing out of the ordinary... [name], how was Lake Valor? Anything to report? What? You’re just going there now? You’ve got to move faster than that!
Rowan: [name], how was Lake Valor? Anything to report? What? You’re just going there now? You’ve got to move faster than that!

npcs.name: Counterpart
says: Dawn: [name], how was Lake Valor? There’s nothing wrong here. The lake hasn’t changed at all. We haven’t found a legendary Pokémon, either, though...
Lucas: Hiya, [name]! How’s Lake Valor? There’s nothing wrong here. The lake is ordinary, as usual. There’s no legendary Pokémon, either...

npcs.name: Mesprit
says: Kyauun.
MESPRIT flew off somewhere...

Rowan: ... ... [name], that was MESPRIT, wasn’t it? You’ve accomplished what I’d asked you to do at the Canalave Library... I asked you to get data on the Pokémon of the lake, and you did. But it didn’t provide any answers about the mysteries of evolution. I still don’t know why some Pokémon evolve and others don’t. Ultimately, it only deepened the mystery. But having mysteries to solve... That adds to my enjoyment!
[name], why don’t you chase after MESPRIT? To me, it seemed as if it wanted to play with you. If you were to use the Pokétch app Marking Map, you’d be able to track the movements of Pokémon.

Go on, [name]. I’m sure that you will keep meeting countless Pokémon and people. Those encounters will keep thrilling you in their own special ways. I hope you’ll enjoy that experience! Take care, [name].
What? You don’t have the Marking Map? ...You should occasionally pay visits to the Pokétch Company, you know.

npcs.name: Hiker
says: Up ahead there’s a huge mountain that towers above everything. It divides Sinnoh into two distinct halves.

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: The Gym Leader went off to work in the mine.
The Gym Leader is young, but he’s the mine’s safety supervisor. He’s an expert in more than just one field!

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: Everyone’s proud of the mine. They’re digging for coal under the sea as we speak... It’s amazing how they do it!

npcs.name: Rival
says: [name]: Hunh? Oh, it’s you, [name]! You finally got here? You’re slow like always. But anyway, the Gym Leader’s tough! Like, seriously serious! If the Gym Leader’s this tough, I wonder how he compares to my dad... Huh? I just drifted there. Anyway, the Gym Leader’s gone off to the coal mine. If you want to take on the Gym Leader, you’d better go off to the mine!
[name]: I told you, the Gym Leader went down to the Oreburgh Mine. If you want to take the Gym challenge, you have to go down to the mine.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: Is that guy in front of the Gym your friend? He’s sort of twitchy and impatient.
Can I see your Trainer Case? It’s got the Gym Badge you just won, right?
Oh, hi, you’re back! The Gym Leader’s waiting for you.

npcs.name: Worker1
says: These vents exchange the hot air down below with the fresh air outside. Looking down them gives me the urge to start yelling into ’em! Hello!

npcs.name: Worker2
says: There’s no question. This is hard, hard work. But working alongside Pokémon... It gives me a boost somehow. Here, take one of these.
Feeling hale and hearty puts a smile on my face. And that makes me happy.

npcs.name: Camper
says: When I run around with my Running Shoes on, I’m the center of attention! ...At least that’s what it feels like. There’s always someone looking at me.

npcs.name: Worker3
says: This pile of dirty sand is called a slag heap. It’s the waste from sorting coal.

npcs.name: Worker4
says: Chop, chop, MACHOP! Chop, chop away on rocks! ~♫

npcs.name: Guitarist
says: Have you seen the vents? They release steam from down below.

npcs.name: Battle Girl1
says: TMs are single use only, but HMs can be used over and over. It’s tricky trying to decide which Pokémon should learn what moves.

npcs.name: Machop1
says: MACHOP: Macho! Chopo!

npcs.name: Machop3
says: MACHOP: Pigyooh!

npcs.name: Machop2
says: MACHOP: Gwooh! Gogogooh!

npcs.name: Battle Girl2
says: Natural time capsules buried many, many years ago... That’s what Fossils are.

npcs.name: Pokefan M
says: Hiya! Your Pokémon could use some toughening up. Why not try training in the Oreburgh Mine?

npcs.name: Hiker
says: I always have a rotten time trying to decide which moves my Pokémon should learn.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M
says: You remind me so much of the time I got my first Pokémon.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: Wow... Your Pokémon’s eyes are twinkling brightly! Seeing that makes me happy! Here, I want you to have this!
You know how Pokémon stay inside their Poké Balls? I try to think about what would be the best Poké Balls for them.

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: The Oreburgh Mine is operated with the utmost care. We avoid causing any damage to the natural habitats of Pokémon.

npcs.name: Scientist M
says: Coal is carried out of Oreburgh Mine on a fully automated system. Machines do all the work automatically. So, it’s all very easy.

npcs.name: Hiker
says: The Badges that Pokémon Gyms give you are a measure of a Trainer’s worth. By getting more Badges, you get to buy more items in Poké Marts.

npcs.name: Collector
says: The Poké Mart is staffed by a lady and a young fellow. They offer different kinds of merchandise. Did you know?

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: Roark is a user of Rock-type Pokémon. Don’t you think Rock-type Pokémon are nice? I like how lumpy they are!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: Roark is our town’s Gym Leader. He may be young, but he keeps the mine running safely and efficiently.

npcs.name: Expert F
says: A Pokémon obtained in a trade grows quickly. But if a Pokémon grows too much, it may ignore the Trainer. Of course, it won’t matter if you have lots of Gym Badges.

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: Listen, listen. Do you have a Pokémon called MACHOP? Would you be willing to trade your MACHOP for my ABRA?
Thanks to Pokémon, I got to be friends with you!
Be nice to my ABRA! I’ll be sure to look after your MACHOP in return!
Oh, OK... Well, I can’t make you trade me. But if you change your mind, I’ll be right here waiting!
What I asked for was a MACHOP...

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder M
says: When you trade a Pokémon, the item it’s holding is traded as well. That’s pretty cool, huh? It means you can send an item as a gift along with your Pokémon in a trade!

npcs.name: Guitarist
says: All Pokémon have a special power called an ability.

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder F
says: My favorite Pokémon ability is my PACHIRISU’s Pickup. My darling picks up a lot of dropped items without me noticing!

npcs.name: Collector
says: The view is good from the second floor, but it’s a pain going outside. If you don’t mind, how about showing me a Pokémon called GEODUDE? Oh! That Pokémon! That’s a GEODUDE! Wow, that’s cool... It’s so cute... That does it! I’ll go out and catch Pokémon, too! Thank you, my friend! This is a token of my thanks!
Yeah, there are so many kinds of Pokémon out in the world. I want to see them all now!
The view is good from the second floor, but it’s a pain going outside. If you don’t mind, how about showing me a Pokémon called GEODUDE?

npcs.name: Breeder M
says: There are eight Gym Leaders in the Sinnoh region. The objective for Trainers is to get Gym Badges from them all. That means you have to defeat all of them in battles at their Gyms!

npcs.name: Youngster
says: A Gym Leader isn’t like just any Trainer you meet. Obviously, they’re a lot tougher. A lot. I’d take as many Pokémon as possible if I were you.

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: Roark lets us train our Pokémon in the mine.

npcs.name: Worker
says: Giving nicknames to Pokémon is the way to go. It makes you feel as if they’re your very own.

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: But he named our PSYDUCK “Yellow” just because of its color... I don’t understand the logic behind that at all.

npcs.name: Lass
says: Are you catching Pokémon? Here, take this if you’d like.
The Dusk Ball is a Poké Ball designed for use in darkness. It works better if you use it at night or in a cave.

npcs.name: Psyduck
says: Yellow: Duuuck?

npcs.name: Psychic
says: Hmmm...! What is your favorite kind of Trainer? Can you tell me?
Hello! You’ve been mistaken for [name], haven’t you? But I think you can also pass for a different kind of Trainer. So, how about telling me what kind of Trainer that you like?
Which kind of Trainer would you like to be?
[name] is the kind of Trainer you want to be?
OK, then I’ll just talk to you later!
I see! So [name] is the kind of Trainer you like. If that’s the case, others may come to see you in the same way.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: Switch on the PC at any Pokémon Center. Connect to “Someone’s PC” and access the Pokémon Storage System. That’s all you need to do to store or bring out your Pokémon.

npcs.name: Ninja Boy
says: Yay! I got a Pal Pad at the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club downstairs!

npcs.name: Gentleman
says: Hmmm! What, or who, is this Team Galactic?! They make wonderful claims of a dream energy source on one hand... But rumor has it, they steal Pokémon from others by force. It’s a mystery! They’re mysterious! Isn’t anyone investigating them?
Hmmm! What, or who, is this Team Galactic?! Lately, they’ve renounced such acts as stealing Pokémon. They’re still involved in developing dream energies, but ethically now.

npcs.name: Kid With NDSWest
says: You know how you can battle a friend using wireless communications? Well now, you can capture it as a Battle Video using a Vs. Recorder!

npcs.name: Kid With NDSEast
says: Cool! You have a Vs. Recorder! So, did you go to the Global Terminal in Jubilife City? Did ya? Did ya?

npcs.name: Battle Girl
says: I want to become friends with an experienced Trainer I really admire. I can’t wait for us to register each other in our Pal Pads. Then, we can play together using the Wi-Fi Club!

npcs.name: Worker
says: You’re taking a tour of our coal mine? Wonderful! That’s excellent of you. It’s always good to learn about new things and broaden your horizons!

npcs.name: Youngster
says: Have you ever seen or heard about differently colored Pokémon? For instance, a regular PIKACHU has a yellow body, correct? Well, the different-colored PIKACHU has a sort of orange body.

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: You know how Pokémon have different natures like we have personalities? I don’t think it’s surprising to see Pokémon in different colors.

npcs.name: Pikachu
says: PIKACHU: Pikaaah!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: Oh! Good golly! That’s Oreburgh City’s Gym Badge! All right! Now you can use the hidden move Rock Smash on small boulders!

That sparkling new Pokétch! Your awkwardness as a traveler! Hmm... You’re still a pretty new Trainer, aren’t you? But it’s all good! You’re a new fellow friend of Pokémon! So, let me make a gift of this Hidden Machine to you!

That Hidden Machine, or HM for short, contains the hidden move Rock Smash. A Pokémon learning Rock Smash can smash small boulders in the field. But the Trainer has to have the Gym Badge from Oreburgh City. If you don’t have that Badge, you can’t make a Pokémon use the hidden move Rock Smash outside of battle.

npcs.name: Cyclist F
says: Do you see those bumps on the ground? It feels awesome taking those fast on a Bicycle.

items.where: Oreburgh City Gym: given by Roark

npcs.name: Roark
says: Welcome! This is the Oreburgh Pokémon Gym! I’m Roark, the Gym Leader! I’m but one Trainer who decided to walk proudly with Rock-type Pokémon! As the Gym Leader, I need to see your potential as a Trainer. And, I’ll need to see the toughness of the Pokémon that battle with you!

This is embarrassing... I went and lost to a Trainer who didn’t have a single Gym Badge... But that’s tough. You were strong, and I was weak. That’s all there is. According to Pokémon League rules, I have to give you our Gym Badge since you’ve beaten me, the Leader. Here’s your official Pokémon League Coal Badge.
[name] received the Coal Badge from Roark!
Having that Coal Badge means your Pokémon can now use the hidden move Rock Smash outside of battle. You should also take this, too.
In this region of Sinnoh, there are seven other Gym Leaders. I should warn you--they’re a lot tougher than I am!

That [name] contains the move Stealth Rock. It’s a move that inflicts damage on foes that switch into battle. Incidentally, a TM will teach its move to a Pokémon instantly. But a TM will break when you use it, so make certain you want a Pokémon to learn that move.

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: Howdy! How’s it going, Champ-to-be? That’s what I said to a really impatient boy earlier, too. The Gym Leader is a user of Rock-type Pokémon. Well, listen. Rock-type Pokémon really hate water, all right? They’re also weak to Grass-type moves. Gee, they sure have weaknesses! But don’t think it will be easy. You don’t get to be a Gym Leader without covering for weaknesses. Going after a Rock-type Pokémon with a Fire-type Pokémon won’t be easy, either. That’s all the advice I can give. Thanks for listening!
Oh! [name]! You’ve taken care of the Gym Leader! So, did my advice come in handy or what? If my advice was useful, it’d be great if you’d become my fan!

items.where: B1f: on the ground at tile (19, 4)
B1f: given by Hiker
B2f: on the ground at tile (4, 28)
B2f: on the ground at tile (26, 24)

npcs.name: Worker
says: Everyone that works in the coal mine keeps their own Pokémon with them. You may be challenged to battles! Hahaha!

npcs.name: Twin
says: I found what I thought were some rocks, then they started moving! They were Pokémon that looked just like rocks!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: Hello! How do you do! I’m a student of philosophy. If I had to explain very simply, I study how people came to be. That could explain why I happen to be in Sinnoh. In Sinnoh, there is a myth on how the world came into existence. Investigating that myth may give me insight on the emergence of people. I found something very interesting soon after arrival. You may have it, if you’d like.
Well, hello! About that very interesting thing I found... You may have it, if you’d like.

I’m told that Plate was created at the same time as Sinnoh. That Plate I found bears this inscription. “The rightful bearer of a Plate draws from the Plate it holds.” The rightful bearer, I think, may point to the shaper of this world. Oh, by the way, I’m only interested in the words and thoughts left behind. Physical artifacts like that Plate don’t interest me once I’ve read them. I hope we meet again somewhere.

npcs.name: Roark
says: OK, stand back and watch this. Using the hidden move Rock Smash, a boulder blocking your way...

npcs.name: Worker
says: I met these MACHOP on Route 207. They’ve now become my most trusted partners!

npcs.name: Machop1
says: MACHOP: Maaacho!

npcs.name: Machop2
says: MACHOP: Chopmacho!

npcs.name: Machop3
says: MACHOP: Chopchop!

npcs.name: Hiker
says: Whoa! So this is coal? I never expected something this big! And that color! It really is as black as they say!

npcs.name: Twin
says: Wow! The Pokémon that carried this must be terribly strong!

npcs.name: School Kid M
says: Well, how about that! The Oreburgh Mine extends under the seafloor!

npcs.name: Fossil Researcher
says: Hello, hello! How are you? I study Pokémon Fossils! Me! Right here and now!
You have a Fossil for me, yes? Shall I turn it into a Pokémon?
I am in the process of extracting your Pokémon from a Fossil. You go outside, yes, please. Now! Time alone is what I now need. NOW!!!
On the verge of a breakthrough, I am, to achieve extraction from Fossils. From Fossils I can extract Pokémon, but not yet, not yet.
You were gone too long! You kept us waiting! Unacceptable! This is your [name]! You be good to it, OK!
[name] received the [name]!
Give a nickname to the [name] you received?
If it is a Fossil that you obtain, bring it to me if you must.
You don’t wish that I extract any Pokémon from a Fossil. Fine, then!
But, no, I cannot do this! You have too many Pokémon with you! I must hold it for you, so come back, you, and take it away, please.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: Hello! Welcome to the Oreburgh Mining Museum!

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder F
says: It’s a little far from here, but there is a city called Eterna City. I’ve heard a curious person named the Underground Man lives there. With a name like that, he must be an authority on the Underground.

npcs.name: Collector
says: Mining must take a strong mind, not just a tough body. Think about it. You’re in darkness, digging desperately through rock.

npcs.name: Expert M
says: The history of Oreburgh Mine... You could call it a history of effort and friendship between people and Pokémon.

npcs.name: Worker
says: You haven’t caught all your Pokémon yet, but... Would you like to retire from your Catching Show?
That’s the spirit, [name]! I like how you don’t give up!
I see... I’m disappointed that you dropped out. Make up for it next time!

npcs.name: Poketch App Lady
says: Pal Park is so scintillating! Trainers and Pokémon are so full of intensity here!
I’ve never seen some Pokémon. Would you show me if you had one?
Let me see... A Pokémon that does nothing but eat and sleep.
Oh, a SNORLAX? It sure looks like it can eat! I have a Pokétch app that has a SNORLAX motif. You can have it for showing me a real SNORLAX!
Doesn’t that [name] make you want to cook something?
Changing colors can change your mood, too.
Pal Park is so scintillating! Trainers and Pokémon are so full of intensity here! Are you taking the challenge, too?
Let me see... A Pokémon that changes color whenever something happens.
Oh, a KECLEON! How colorful! I have a Pokétch app that features a KECLEON design. You can have it for showing me a real KECLEON!
What was that Pokémon’s name now...? Oh, it’s on the tip of my tongue!

npcs.name: Complaints Lady
says: I’ve heard Trainers complain that rare Pokémon take longer to appear. Is it easier to start with common Pokémon?

npcs.name: Record Guy
says: The current record holder is [name] with [name] points. Can you top that?

npcs.name: Daughter
says: Oh, [name]! I hope you do better next time.
Eek! [name]! Your Catching Show was fantastic! I hope I can become an expert Trainer like you one day!
I came to see [name]’s Catching Show with Daddy. I hope it starts soon...

npcs.name: Dad
says: [name], my daughter is a big fan of yours. A day doesn’t go by without her demanding we come see Catching Shows.

npcs.name: Show Watcher Boy
says: People come here not only to see the Catching Show. We get to see rare and exotic Pokémon on top of the catches. The excitement gets me all jacked up!

npcs.name: Worker
says: Welcome to Pal Park! This is where top-notch Trainers come to demonstrate their Pokémon-catching techniques to their peers. ...Oh? Are you maybe... Ah, you are [name]! We’ve all heard rumors about you! Word is, you’re a hotshot Trainer?! We’d be honored if you would participate in our Catching Shows.
Hi there, [name]! Did you come to participate in a Catching Show?
Yes! You agreed to participate! It’s a happy day for me! Let’s not waste any time! Let me explain how Pal Park works. I wrote the Pal Park manual for situations just like this. What should I explain?
Aww, that’s too bad. Well, just give me a shout if you’d like to participate.
Very well, let me explain how things work around here. I’ll read to you from the Pal Park manual I wrote.

Pal Park is a place where you are timed on the catching of six Pokémon. You are provided with six special Poké Balls for the challenge. Participating Trainers are required to supply the six Pokémon that are to be caught. If you do not supply the stock of six Pokémon, you may not participate in the Catching Show. ...Do you want me to explain anything else?
At the start of the Catching Show, you will be given six Park Balls. Use the Park Balls to catch the six Pokémon you provide. ...Do you want me to explain anything else?

You may make Pokémon migrate from Kanto or Hoenn. Doing so will stock your Catching Game. Insert a Game Boy Advance Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed, or LeafGreen in the Game Pak slot. When your DS is turned on, currently caught Pokémon can migrate from the Game Pak to the DS Game Card. ...Do you want me to explain anything else?
Would you like to take part in a Catching Show now?
Oh, your PC Boxes are filled. You have no room for six more Pokémon. You won’t be able to accept them, even if you do catch them. Make enough room in a PC Box and come back for your Catching Show.
Oh, hold on. You don’t have enough Pokémon for a Catching Show. You’ll need to stock us with six Pokémon to participate. You should make some Pokémon migrate from Kanto or Hoenn!
OK, here are your Park Balls! [name] received six Park Balls. The current record holder is [name] with [name] points. OK, off you go, [name]. Dazzle us with a masterful display of Pokémon catching!

npcs.name: GBASlot Gift Lady
says: Not only are there Catching Shows, there are also Pokémon Contests... It’s so dreamy... Sinnoh sets my heart aflutter.
Your performance left my heart aflutter today... I must crown you with this... Crown. Oh, before you get the wrong idea, it’s an Accessory for Pokémon.
Your performance left my heart aflutter today... I feel compelled to give you this Tiara. Oh, before you get the wrong idea, it’s an Accessory for Pokémon.
Your performance left my heart aflutter today... I wish you would take this “Seafloor” Backdrop. Please try using it when dressing up your Pokémon with Accessories.
Your performance left my heart aflutter today... I wish you would take this “Underground” Backdrop. Please try using it when dressing up your Pokémon with Accessories.
Your performance left my heart aflutter today... I wish you would take this “Sky” Backdrop. Please try using it when dressing up your Pokémon with Accessories.

The Catching Show... It’s a head-on clash of will and wits between Trainer and Pokémon. I especially look forward to seeing Pokémon from Kanto and Hoenn. But it tugs at my heartstrings to know they’re so far away from home.

Northeast House: given by Ace Trainer M
Northeast House: given by Ace Trainer M

npcs.name: Picnicker
says: Some Trainers deliberately prevent their Pokémon from evolving. They wait until the Pokémon levels up and learns certain moves.

npcs.name: Black Belt
says: Pastoria’s Gym Leader is awesome with his water attacks. You’ll know what I mean when you challenge him.

Wasn’t the Pastoria Gym Leader kind of awesome in all sorts of ways? But don’t judge him by the way he looks and acts. I hear he enters professional wrestling matches for prize money. That money goes to help people and Pokémon in trouble.

npcs.name: Clefairy
says: CLEFAIRY: Fiiih?!

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M1
says: The Great Marsh keeps the weather cool in the summertime. This is a good town for Water-type Pokémon.

npcs.name: Collector1
says: Here where I am standing, I’m smack-dab in the middle of town.

npcs.name: Scientist M
says: I study rare Pokémon that appear only in the Great Marsh.

npcs.name: Beauty
says: I’m visiting here to see the Great Marsh. I’m staying at the lakeside hotel.

npcs.name: Grunt M
says: Grr... The package hasn’t arrived from the Veilstone warehouse yet... I have to wait here until then? I’m going batty from this wait... Oh, man, I wish I could do something that involved lots of explosives! Yup, this is going to be a smashing job for Team Galactic...

What’s with you? Stop chasing after me, you. I’ve half a mind to pulverize you with my Pokémon! But I have to be on my way to the lake ASAP! So, you’re lucky! I’m out! All right, do I make myself clear? Don’t you dare follow me!

npcs.name: Parasol Lady
says: You’re just like a totally impatient boy I met earlier. Just like you, he was very close with his Pokémon. Hey, thanks for making me smile! This might put a smile on your face. Try dressing up a Pokémon with this [name].
Someone gave me a Berry, so I planted it and grew some more. Then, I took the Berries and cooked them into Poffins. All the work is worth it when I see how happy they make my Pokémon!

npcs.name: Collector2
says: I can’t use the hidden move Surf until I beat the local Gym Leader.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M2
says: Have you been to the Pokémon Mansion? It’s on Route 212. The owner, Mr. Backlot, likes to brag about his herd of rare Pokémon.

npcs.name: Rival
says: [name]: Oh, hey, [name]. You’re out of luck, though. The Gym Leader, Crasher Wake, I mean Mr. Wake’s gone off to Veilstone. They said he had a practice match with Veilstone’s Gym Leader Maylene. Sheesh! I ended up missing him completely!
[name]: What’s the matter?! Why aren’t you gone already?! Go after that Galactic goon!
[name]: Why are you talking to me from there?!
[name]: Does my new outfit look good or what? CROAGUNK’s where it’s at.

npcs.name: Crasher Wake
says: Wake: The Great Marsh is invaluable...
[name]: Hey! What am I, chopped liver? Don’t forget I’m here, too!
Wake: So, where’s this Galac...
DDDOOOMMM!!
Grunt: Fweh! That was rough.
Wake: YOU! What’ve you done?!

Grunt: What’ve I done, you’re asking? Well, technically speaking, it wasn’t me. The package that arrived, see, that was a bomb, named the Galactic Bomb. Me, I was told to push the button. So I did. Like, “Poink!” Oh, that’s right! Mustn’t forget! The test results need reporting! Cheerio, then! You daft codger, your mask’s absurd!
You two! Do NOT follow me! Don’t let anyone else in, either! There’d be big trouble if there’s any of that bomb left!
[name]: Hey! [name]! You go after that Galactic goon! I’m staying here like Master said! Gotta keep others from going in! Don’t let that Galactic guy get away!

npcs.name: Move Maniac
says: Everyone calls me the Pokémon Move Maniac. I prefer Move Tutor. I know every move that Pokémon learn while they’re leveling up, and I can teach Pokémon those moves. I can teach a move to a Pokémon of yours if you’d like. I’ll do it if you’ll trade me a Heart Scale.
If any of your Pokémon needs to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
Oh! That’s it! That’s an honest-to- goodness Heart Scale! Let me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
Which Pokémon needs tutoring?
Which move should I teach?
[name] handed over [name] in exchange.
Hunh? Don’t you think it’d be tough for an Egg to learn a move?
Sorry... There isn’t any move I can teach that Pokémon.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: I often go to Solaceon Town for my big brother. The newspaper there gives me Heart Scales for running errands.

npcs.name: Bug Catcher
says: The Pokémon CROAGUNK is the city’s official mascot. CROAGUNK sure is purdy--we’re hopin’ it’ll get popular ’round the world.

npcs.name: School Girl
says: Put Seals on the Capsule, then put it on a Poké Ball... And done! Another Poké Ball made by me! It’s one of a kind! Giggle... Are you using Ball Capsules?

npcs.name: Old Man
says: The Pokémon COMBEE is quite interesting. Only the female evolves and grows strong. The male does not. Come to think of it, my wife was awfully strong, too. She evolved from my bride to the mother of our kids.

npcs.name: Bug Catcher
says: Hey, have you caught both the female and male forms of COMBEE? If you have, I want to see both of them together. I’ll give you a Macho Brace if you do that for me. Deal?
You’re good! You’d make an awesome Bug Maniac!
Cool! A female and a male COMBEE. I feel giddy! Here’s your reward like I promised. Go ahead, take it!

Aww, you don’t even have a single COMBEE? It’s so cute how they’re attracted by the aroma of Honey. Let me see a male and female COMBEE together, OK? I’ll give you a Macho Brace if you do that for me.

That’s it! A COMBEE! It’s sooooo cute! It’d be even cooler if you had the other gender COMBEE as well, though. By the way, a female COMBEE’s kind of rare, so they’re popular. Still, it’d be great to see a male and female at the same time. I’ll give you a Macho Brace if you do that for me.

npcs.name: Scientist M
says: In the Great Marsh, Quick Trams on rails are used for transportation. They prevent damage to the Great Marsh’s ecosystem.

npcs.name: Psyduck
says: PSYDUCK: Gwah?!

npcs.name: Kid With NDS
says: Though the name says “Quick,” their movements are anything but! They’re the Quick Trams that traverse the Great Marsh.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer M
says: I’m out of scarves to give you! I’m out of things to say, too!
Howdy, there! Let me examine your Pokémon to see if it’s worthy of a scarf!
Hmhm... I see...

This isn’t what I had hoped to see... I can’t lie to you, so I’ll just have to tell it to you straight. This Pokémon’s not bad, but it’s not good, either. It’s just so-so. If you want to improve this one’s condition, feed it some more Poffins!
Your [name]’s looking good! I’d say it’s pretty impressive! I’ll tell you what, I’ll give you this [name]!
The Red Scarf stands for passion! Let a Pokémon hold it to give it an edge in Cool Contests.
The Blue Scarf represents the vastness of the sea! Let a Pokémon hold it to give it an edge in Beauty Contests.
The Pink Scarf represents charm! Let a Pokémon hold it to give it an edge in Cute Contests.
The Green Scarf represents the spring breeze! Let a Pokémon hold it to give it an edge in Smart Contests.
The Yellow Scarf stands for toughness! Let a Pokémon hold it to give it an edge in Tough Contests.

npcs.name: Battle Girl
says: My brother’s girlfriend is the Massage Girl in Veilstone City. They stay in touch by having Pokémon hold Mail for each other.

npcs.name: Pachirisu
says: PACHIRISU: Suuu pasuu!

npcs.name: Cashier F
says: Welcome to the Great Marsh! Is this your first Safari Game?

When you enter the Great Marsh, you start with 30 Safari Balls. That’s the only kind of Ball you’re allowed to use in the Safari Game. The game is over when you run out of Safari Balls, or when you’ve walked 500 steps. Please do enjoy the untamed nature of the Great Marsh!
I see. Enjoy your Safari Game!

npcs.name: Cowgirl
says: Howdy. You’re playing the Safari Game? How would you like to try my game out at the same time? The rule--yep, there’s only one--is real simple. All you have to do is capture five or more Pokémon in one Safari Game. If you can do that, I’ll give you the Pokétch app Matchup Checker.
The Matchup Checker app figures out how Pokémon types match up. It won’t help tell us how we match up as friends, though.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: Tell me I’m not imagining this... The Great Marsh’s Pokémon seem to be different from the ones yesterday...

npcs.name: Bug Catcher
says: Use a pair of binoculars to look out over the Great Marsh. You can see what kinds of Pokémon can be caught, and where they are.

npcs.name: Pokefan M
says: There are shuttle trains in the marsh called Quick Trams. You should take those if you’re going to a deeper area in the marsh.

npcs.name: Picnicker
says: When you’re walking on the bog, you sometimes sink right in... There’s something pretty cool about it, though. If you turn while you’re stuck, sometimes Pokémon may pop out.

npcs.name: Black Belt
says: The Great Marsh is vast! How vast is it, you ask? Take a look from the Observatory and you can see for yourself!

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: Pastoria’s Great Marsh was once a part of the sea. The seawater drained slowly away over time, leaving the huge marshland. That’s why they say there are rare Pokémon that you can only see here.

npcs.name: Artist
says: I derive so much pleasure from working on drawings with others... It shows me that I’m not alone.

npcs.name: Pokemon Breeder F
says: I’ve been hiking all around the Sinnoh region. I love planting Berries wherever I go. I’ll give you a Berry, too. Please plant it somewhere.
Planting Berries is good for Pokémon. It provides them with more things to eat in the wild.

npcs.name: Twin
says: My sister gathers Berries every day! Please come visit again! We cook the Berries, too! We mix them up! They’re yummy!

items.where: Pastoria City Gym: given by Wake

npcs.name: Wake
says: Welcome! I don’t get challenged very often! The glory you are now beholding is the Pastoria Gym Leader! That’s right, I’m Crasher Wake! My Pokémon were toughened up by stormy white waters! They’ll take everything you can throw at them and then pull you under! Victory will be ours! Come on, let’s get it done!
It seems the undertow pulled me under... But I had a great time battling with you! You’ve earned this!
[name] received the Fen Badge from Wake!
You need that Fen Badge to use the hidden move Surf outside of battle. This is a special reward from me in recognition of your team’s power.
The styles of battling and winning are as widely varied as Trainers are. Do you want to know how I battle? I battle so I can say I had fun at the end, whether I win or lose!
That [name] contains the move [name]. It inflicts double the damage on targets with less than half their HP left. Use it to end battles decisively!

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: The Gym Leader Wake... Uh, I mean Crasher Wake, is a master of Water-type Pokémon. I’d say you’ve got guts if you try to face down Water types with Fire- or Ground-type Pokémon! But that part I’ll leave up to you! Go and have some good battles!

says: Hello, hello! How, I say, do you do? I am the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman! Indeed, yes I am! When you wish to treat your Pokémon to a treat, what, I say, do you do? If I were to give a Sweet Poffin, the Pokémon eating it would become more cute! For example! A Spicy Poffin will add to the coolness of a Pokémon! In such ways I say that Poffins have nothing but goodness for Pokémon! Therefore! I declare this Poffin Case to be a gift from me to you!
I urge you to fill it with Poffins and be generous in dispensing them to your Pokémon!

items.where: Sandgem Town Pokemon Research Lab: given by Prof Rowan

npcs.name: Prof Rowan
says: Rowan: Oh, yes, [name]. If you see Cynthia, please give her my best regards.
Rowan: The world is immense. There are many more Pokémon. That means there are many more thrills for you to seek and enjoy!
Rowan: Go on! [name], your grand adventure awaits you!
Rowan: Hm! [name], I’ve been waiting to see you! You’ve met every kind of Pokémon there is in the Sinnoh region! This will help immensely with my studies on Pokémon evolution...
Rowan: Ah, [name]! You’ve come to show me your progress on the Pokédex?

Oak: Greetings, Professor Rowan! It’s been a very long time! I’ll tell you, Sinnoh certainly is a long trip from Kanto. Of course, if it means meeting new Pokémon, there’s no distance too great for the likes of us to travel.

Rowan: Oh! If it isn’t my old colleague, Professor Oak! I should have expected as much from the world’s authority on Pokémon! We always used to joke, “Where there are Pokémon, you’ll find Oak!” It’s good to see that hasn’t changed one bit!
Professor Oak, let me introduce you to my young assistant. This youngster has filled every page of the Sinnoh Pokédex for me.

Oak: Ah, well, very glad to meet you! As you’ve heard, my name is Oak. I’ve been hearing a great deal about you from Professor Rowan lately. He’s been exuberant in praise about a fantastic young Trainer. I see that you live up to--no--that you’ve surpassed his praise. You’ve also got an impeccable sense of timing. You see, I had an errand to run for Professor Rowan on my visit here. He’d asked me to bring the data for the National Pokédex, you see. So, since you’re here, let me upgrade your Pokédex with the National Mode. After all, there are many kinds of Pokémon in this world of ours!
[name]’s Pokédex was upgraded with the National Mode!
Oak: I’m afraid it won’t be easy to complete the National Pokédex. However, I’m sure you will make an honest attempt on our behalf!
Rowan: Have no fear, [name] will get the job done. By the way, Professor Oak, what compelled you to visit this region?

Oak: Ah, yes. I’ve heard that the Pal Park is now open. If I remember correctly, it’s at the end of Route 221. The Pal Park has a special system that attracts every imaginable kind of Pokémon from every region. I’ve come to make certain that system is operating properly.
Rowan: Off he goes, as busy as ever...
Now, [name]... I have a gift here as your reward for completing the Sinnoh Pokédex.

Rowan: That’s the Pokémon Radar, or just Poké Radar for short. Use it, and it will indicate grass patches where Pokémon are lurking. I’d prepared that to help my field assistants put together the Sinnoh Pokédex, but you took care of that! I’m sure it will be useful for your goal of filling the National Pokédex.
What’s wrong? You’re not going to tell me you’ve seen too few to bother showing me?
Hmm... So, you’ve seen [name] Pokémon.
Excellent work, [name]! The Pokémon of the Sinnoh region are being added to your Pokédex. This will certainly help with my studies of Pokémon evolution...
[name], you should make an effort to visit the Pal Park, too. Oops! I’ll be late for my meeting if I don’t get going! OK, it was a pleasure seeing the both of you! Bye, now!

npcs.name: Scientist M
says: I’m [name]’s father. I’ll be happy to assist you on your quest for the professor. Hahaha. Eh... I’m sure we can count on you!
I... I’m stunned by your greatness! I feel as shaken and inspired as when my child was born! Oh, how wonderful it is to be alive!

It’s really quite something! Imagine... Cataloging every kind of Pokémon in the Sinnoh region! And in complete contrast, there’s [name]... Anyway, you’ve been great for the prof’s Pokémon-evolution research!

npcs.name: Scientist F
says: Professor Rowan invented a new Pokédex while working alongside a professor from the Kanto region. Oh, my name is Roseanne. It’s an honor to be an assistant to our professor!
Hearing what was happening from the professor gave me shivers. But he strongly stated that you will make everything all right. I believed that you would make it, and here you are!
Yes, that’s correct. Professor Rowan has been studying Pokédex systems with Professor Oak. Professor Oak is Professor Rowan’s junior in terms of seniority.

npcs.name: Middle Aged Man
says: Is that right? You’re a traveler? Yes, it’s good to see other places!
Do you know about Mt. Moon in the Kanto region? CLEFAIRY dancing under the moon... It’s something I must see in my life.
Have you heard of the Tin Tower in the Johto region? The rainbow-colored Pokémon... I must see that during my lifetime.
Do you know about the Space Center in the Hoenn region? A rocket launching into space... I must see that during my lifetime.
Have you heard of the Whirl Islands in the Johto region? The silver-colored Pokémon... I must see that during my lifetime.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: This hotel is so romantic... I hope a knight on a Pokémon will sweep me away for a honeymoon here!

npcs.name: Policeman
says: Ah, hello. You wish to stay a night? Ah, but you’ve no reservations. I’m afraid we are totally booked. You may rest a while, if you wish.
We’ve restored your Pokémon to full health. We hope to see you again!

npcs.name: Looker
says: Looker: Ah, my friend, it is you! Yes, I am at this hotel now. I am interviewing the people to see if they have seen anyone suspicious. I would like your assistance. Go search outside, if you will. The suspect, he may have already slipped away ahead unnoticed.
Looker: Is that so? The champion of Hoenn has stayed here? But that is of no importance! A suspicion-arousing character, yes, but your bragging is not necessary!
Inside the hotel, I will search. You, I ask to search outside. The suspect, he may have already slipped away ahead unnoticed.

npcs.name: Rich Boy
says: The reservations were full up, but they managed to get us in here. We’re finally alone, the two of us, if you’d leave, that is. This is something we don’t need anymore. Will you take it?
I’ve always relied on the old Coin Toss to make any decision. It gives me courage because I’m not accountable for my decisions.

npcs.name: Lady
says: We wanted to be together alone so we could talk without being disturbed. We really need this time together, just the two of us.
That Coin Toss is why we ended up in this musty, old, and stinky suite...

npcs.name: Clown
says: We’re a traveling troupe of street performers. In place of a formal introduction, please take this!

Trick Room is a doozy of a weird time-twister move. Use it, and for a while afterward, the slowest Pokémon move first! Before the faster can move, the slowest gets to attack! How you use the move is up to you, Trainer...

npcs.name: Psychic
says: Let me gaze into your eyes... I will read your fortune... ...

Many are the eyes that I have gazed into over the years, be they human or Pokémon... But your eyes swirl with compassion, strength, joy, sorrow, and more... The ever-shifting colors in your eyes make you difficult to read...
Destiny shall shift... Whether that bodes well or ill is beyond the spectrum of my sight...

npcs.name: Guitarist
says: Me, I’m just a simple guy. I let my guitar do all my talking. All I need is music and Pokémon. I can shine wherever I go if I have those things in my life. I hear there are guys like me who go around Pokémon Centers.

npcs.name: Fisherman
says: There’s a fancy hotel in a fancy place with a fancy restaurant. The fancy restaurant’s filled with fancy people who think of themselves as being too fancy to battle alone.

npcs.name: Grunt M
says: We needed the energy from the Valley Windworks to make this... It would take a scientific genius to make something like this... Therefore, our boss, who made this, is a scientific mechanical genius!
Graw! You were eavesdropping! I was just thinking out loud! But I’m not going to waste my energy knocking you around...
But, boy, this Galactic Bomb packs a pretty big wallop. With this baby here there’s not much we can’t blow up. I wonder what they have planned for this?
Graw! You were eavesdropping! I was just thinking out loud! You’re a persistent pest... I’m getting tired of running away... But I’m not going to waste my energy knocking you around...

Looker: Hello, my friend! The cargo that the Team Galactic brought is worrisome, so I have come. ...You say the cargo, it was a bomb? And there was an explosion? The explosion was at the Great Marsh? Furthermore, you are pursuing a man... A man with funny bowl-cut hair. In an outfit that is very strange? In other words, that is the Team Galactic!
Oh, no, no, no! How did I miss it? Ah, Looker, this time you have made a mistake of the ages! The man, who I have seen running away, he was the bearer of the bomb!
Ach! This will not do! Wait! Wait, I say!

npcs.name: Beauty
says: I’d rather be in a pool than the sea. The salty tang of the sea tastes like my tears after a hard day at work...

npcs.name: Collector
says: There’s something on top of this big cliff here! My instincts tell me that, but how am I supposed to climb up?

npcs.name: Pokefan M
says: Footprints are left in the sand when you walk on a beach. Pokémon seem to enjoy leaving footprints as much as people.

npcs.name: School Kid F
says: Listen, do you know about the Battle Frontier?
I guess you’re someone who’s in the know. I hear it’s a fun place with facilities for battling through under different sets of rules.
I guess you’re someone who’s kind of out of the loop. I hear it’s a fun place with facilities for battling consecutively under different sets of rules.
