Southeast House: given by Clown

npcs.name: Guitarist1
says: Yeah, Team Galactic is hiding all sorts of good stuff in their warehouse. I hear they even have a Hidden Machine in there!

npcs.name: Pokefan M
says: The Game Corner is dangerous! Why is it dangerous? It’s so fun, I lose track of time!

npcs.name: Battle Girl1
says: I got a TM as a prize from the Game Corner. I used it on my Pokémon right away!

npcs.name: Lady
says: I came to this city just so I could go shopping at the department store. But with all these rock walls around, this place feels kind of cold.

npcs.name: Battle Girl2
says: I bought a new parasol. But I don’t want it to get rained on, so I watch the TV weather reports.

npcs.name: Roughneck1
says: Maylene is Veilstone’s Gym Leader. Then, there’s Wake in Pastoria... They’re way too tough for me. I can’t even come close to them.

npcs.name: Counterpart
says: Dawn: Hi, [name]! Please, can you help me? Do you remember Team Galactic? Those horrible people? They tried to steal Prof. Rowan’s research results in Jubilife, remember? I ran into them, and they took away my Pokédex. Please, I need your help. Team up and battle with me!

Lucas: Hey! [name]! Listen, I need your help... Remember those Team Galactic goons? The guys who tried to take Prof. Rowan’s research results in Jubilife? I ran into them, and they ripped off my Pokédex! Will you team up with me to take them on?
Dawn: You and your Pokémon together with me and my Pokémon... United like this, our dream team has no chance of losing! I’m not letting those bad people get away with their dirty deeds!
Dawn: I’ll be waiting. Please get ready and come quickly.
Lucas: You and your Pokémon together with me and my Pokémon... Our dream team’s not going to lose. Not with the way we work together! I’m not letting those criminals get away with this!
Lucas: I’ll be waiting! Get ready and come quick!

Grunt 1: Aww, that stinks! Our Pokémon are chumps! We should get new ones from headquarters. Humph! Who cares about some Pokédex anyway? Team Galactic’s going to own all the Pokémon in the world... No, in the universe!
There! Take it! Take your Pokédex!
Grunt 2: Those things we had in the warehouse’ve already been moved to Pastoria City anyway... So, we’ll say “You’ll get yours!” And run like the grunts we are.
Looker: Have no fear, I have come running. I heard of children feuding with the Team Galactic. It turns out, of course, to be you.
Looker: You insult me to my face? How very uncouth of you.
Dawn: What’s going on? Why is Team Galactic out in the streets like they own the place?
Lucas: What’s going on here? Why is Team Galactic out in the streets like they own the place?

Dawn: [name], thank you, sincerely. I would’ve been lost without my Pokédex. It’s indispensable for helping Prof. Rowan with his studies. So, [name], what are you going to do now? I’m thinking of going to the Pokémon Mansion on Route 212. I hear they show rare Pokémon to visitors there.

Lucas: [name], thanks, honestly. I’m useless without my Pokédex. I have to have it for helping Prof. Rowan with his studies. So, [name], what are your plans now? I think I’m off to the Pokémon Mansion on Route 212. They say they show off rare Pokémon to visitors.
Dawn: Oh... It’s that funny man from Jubilife...
Lucas: Hey... It’s that weirdo from Jubilife.
Dawn: I’m terribly sorry. Team Galactic took my Pokédex, so I was very irritated... I just blurted it out... ...I should be going now. Be wary of Team Galactic.
Lucas: Oh, sorry. Honestly. I was upset from having my Pokédex ripped off by Team Galactic. I didn’t even think when I spoke up. I’ll be going now. Uh... Watch out for Team Galactic.

Looker: It is of no matter. Of more interest is the criminal behavior of the Team Galactic. They attempt to steal the belongings of a child? The scale of their criminality, it seems rather minuscule. The triviality of their action makes them more sinister, perhaps. Their warehouse needs investigation. Come with me, and we’ll take a look!

npcs.name: Grunt MWarehouse North
says: Grunt 1: Hey, you! Yeah, you! This is Team Galactic’s warehouse! It ain’t no playground for kids!
Grunt 1: What? Now you’ve brought your buddy along so you can get your Pokédex back? We’ll be just as happy to send both of you crying home to your mommies!

npcs.name: Grunt MWarehouse South
says: Grunt 2: This is the awesome Team Galactic’s awesome warehouse! A little kid like you should be playing at the Pokémon Gym. After all, the Gym Leader happens to be a kid just like you!
Grunt 2: You’re trying to get the Pokédex back from us? Not when we, Team Galactic, can make so much better use of it! But, OK, guarding the warehouse does get boring! We’ll take you on two-on-two!

npcs.name: Guitarist2
says: Do you know where one might find a Coin Case? I heard that there’s a clown giving ’em away, but...

npcs.name: Roughneck2
says: Veilstone is the city of stone. We even have meteorites! This has nothing to do with anything, but take this Technical Machine!
If someone uses Embargo on your Pokémon, it becomes impossible to use any items on it. Anyway, enjoy your visit to Veilstone, the city of...well, stone.

npcs.name: Grunt MStorage Key
says: There! Would you look at those antennae? I don’t know what they do, but those are some mighty impressive antennae!

Hey! It’s you! I bet you don’t remember me, but I sure remember you! Because of you, they took my CLEFAIRY away... My partner called it quits and went back to his old country... Waah! I know nothing! I don’t know anything about any Storage Key!

Ah-hah! You leave this to me! The Storage Key for entering the Team Galactic hideout, I have right here. A frontal assault, it is not possible. But we can enter their hideout. Well? Will you enter the hideout? You have your reasons, yes?
Very well. Inside the Team Galactic warehouse. We will meet there. Prepare the best you can. I shall join you shortly.
Looker: ...Yes, I see your point. Sneaking into the hideout of the Team Galactic...it is daunting.

npcs.name: Grunt MSoutheast
says: We have the Hidden Machine that teaches Fly stored in the warehouse. They said I can use it if I show them that I deserve it.

npcs.name: Looker
says: Looker: [name]!
Very well. Inside the Team Galactic warehouse. We will meet there. Prepare the best you can. I shall join you shortly.

Ah-hah! You leave this to me! The Storage Key for entering the Team Galactic hideout, I have right here. A frontal assault, it is not possible. But we can enter their hideout. Well? Will you enter the hideout? You have your reasons, yes?
Looker: ...Yes, I see your point. Sneaking into the hideout of the Team Galactic...it is daunting.

npcs.name: Battle Girl3
says: A man spoke to me in a foreign language. He really surprised me! I think he was asking if I liked Pokémon or something.

npcs.name: Guitarist3
says: Salut, Trainer! Tu aimes les Pokémon?
Moi aussi! C’est génial!
J’ai du mal à te croire... Il n’y a qu’à vous regarder!

npcs.name: Pokefan M
says: You’re a Trainer, aren’t you? You see, there’s this Pokémon I’d like someone to look after. It’s a Pokémon called PORYGON. I found it near Team Galactic’s building. I’m no Trainer, so can you take it off my hands?
Team Galactic’s building bugs me so much, I can’t sleep well. It’s so bizarre, like a robot that’s about to start moving.
You’re a Trainer, aren’t you? You see, there’s this Pokémon I’d like someone to look after. It’s a Pokémon called PORYGON. Can you take it off my hands?
Excellent! Thanks! That’ll make the PORYGON happy, too. I suspect it ran away from those Team Galactic goons.
[name] accepted the PORYGON!
Would you like to give a nickname to the PORYGON you received?
Is that so... I’ll look after it for a while. Please come see me if you change your mind.
Thanks! ...But, oops, you already have a whole team of Pokémon with you. If you want this PORYGON, you’d better put one in a PC Box first.

npcs.name: Pokefan F
says: Those thorny things on the building... The way it moves meaninglessly... I don’t understand their idea of “awesomely fashionable” at all. Still, Team Galactic does seem to have a huge supply of energy.

npcs.name: Ace Trainer F
says: A myth says that Mt. Coronet parted Sinnoh into halves. Seeing the Pokémon SHELLOS makes me think maybe the myth is real.

npcs.name: Old Woman
says: If there are people who desire to see them, Pokémon will appear in many different guises.

npcs.name: Buneary
says: BUNEARY: Nii nii!

npcs.name: Socialite
says: If you use the hidden move Fly, you’ll be instantly whisked to any town you’ve visited before.

npcs.name: School Kid M
says: Maylene, the Gym Leader, is a cute girl. But don’t let her looks fool you. Even grown-ups have trouble with her.

npcs.name: Expert F
says: I enjoy Nintendo WFC play with my grandkids at the same time every day. It’s so much fun to play Plaza Games with my dear ones.

npcs.name: Clown
says: You there. Watch this Coin.
Spin, spin, spin, spin, spin...
Me, I am but a tearful clown. Though I smile, I cry inside.
Now, which hand is that Coin in? My left or right?
Bravo! A winner is you! For our winner, I have here... A Coin Case!
Boo! Poor show! I challenge you to challenge it again!

npcs.name: Black Belt
says: There are many magicians in the world. You know, the performance artists? Don’t you think that maybe, say, five percent are actually psychics?

npcs.name: Beauty
says: Oh, looking a little tired? ...Oh, no, not you. I meant your Pokémon. If you’d like, I can give a massage to a Pokémon. Would you like that?
Which one needs a little love?
Giggle... OK, let’s get started. OK, sweetie, just relax...
[name] looks dreamily content...
When I was massaging your Pokémon, I found this.
Oh? You want me to show you how to massage Pokémon? Tehehe... It’s a secret, of course! Come back again tomorrow!
Oh! Hey, I’m not doing anything shady...
That’s silly! I’d break that Egg if I tried to massage it!
Drop by again tomorrow if you’d like.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: My sister’s boyfriend is the Scarf Guy in Pastoria City. They send Mail to each other by letting Pokémon deliver it.

npcs.name: Pachirisu
says: PACHIRISU: Pachi chiii!

items.where: Veilstone City Gym: given by Maylene

npcs.name: Maylene
says: Hello. I’m pleased to meet you. I’m Maylene, and I’m the Gym Leader. I don’t really know what it means to be strong, or how I got to be the Gym Leader. But I will do the best I can as the Gym Leader. I take battling very seriously. Whenever you’re ready!
...OK. You win. That was a tough loss. I learned a lot from it. Please, accept this Gym Badge.
[name] received the Cobble Badge from Maylene.

Um... I should explain about that official Pokémon League Gym Badge. With it, you can use the hidden move Fly outside of battle. Oh, and since you now have four Gym Badges, Pokémon obtained in trades will obey you up to Lv. 50. Oh, and please take this as well.

Gee, I’m hungry... Oh, sorry, it’s nothing. I didn’t say anything. [name], I can’t explain what it means to be strong. I don’t know how much effort goes into being strong... But being with Pokémon lets us keep making the effort, doesn’t it?
That [name] contains the move [name]. Um... That move inflicts damage, and it robs the target’s HP.

npcs.name: Gym Guide
says: Hey, there! How’s it going, Champ-to-be? The Gym Leader is a user of Fighting-type Pokémon. She’d be a terror against Normal-type Pokémon. But! And it’s a big but! Just between you and me... Maylene, the Gym Leader, said Flying- and Psychic-type Pokémon could be real trouble for her! If you want to battle her, smack the punching bags along the rails. You have to hit those bags hard!
Oh! [name]! You’ve beaten the Gym Leader! Of course, I thought you’d win.

items.where: buried at tile (86, 849); the Dowsing Machine finds it within 2 tiles

npcs.name: Sailor
says: The Vista Lighthouse represents safety and protection to us Sailors.

npcs.name: Youngster
says: I love how far away you can see with the binoculars. I’m going to go that far away with my Pokémon one day!

npcs.name: Volkner
says: ... ... ...So, you’re the latest challenger up against the Sunyshore Gym...

All right, I’ve decided! If I find you to be weak, I’m going to challenge the Pokémon League. I’m all done with renovating the Gym, so I don’t need to be here. More than anything, I want to have battles that can thrill me again.
As the toughest Gym Leader in Sinnoh, I’m going to unleash everything in my arsenal on you.

npcs.name: Mira
says: [name] decided to go with Mira!
Mira: I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy all the time!
Mira: I like helpful Pokémon moves like Growl and Minimize. Those kinds of moves are my favorites.
I’m Mira... I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost... I’m so scared... Please! Please take me to the exit!
Trainer, your name is [name]? My name is Mira. I like your name!
Mira: [name], did you get to be so good because you’re always with your Pokémon? Yes! That has to be it! Mira will try like you!
Mira: This cave... It’s so easy to get confused. Do you know where we are?

quote.pre: You’re a Pokémon Trainer, and so am I! Our eyes met, so battle we must!
quote.defeat: Too strong! Too strong!

quote.pre: Let’s have a Pokémon battle! Humph! But I’m gonna win!
quote.defeat: You beat me?! You’ve got talent!

quote.pre: I spy, with my little eye... A Trainer! A battle, please!
quote.defeat: Oh, boo! I can’t win!

quote.pre: I get my get-up-and-go from my Pokémon! Here we go! KRICKETOT! ZUBAT!
quote.defeat: Ack! My Pokémon...

quote.pre: I’ll beat you with the MAGIKARP my dad gave me!
quote.defeat: But they’re Pokémon I got from my dad...

quote.pre: May I please trouble you for a battle?
quote.defeat: Oh... You’re so strong...

quote.pre: Oh, a weak-looking Trainer... Do you want to have a go?
quote.defeat: Aww... I should have said no.

quote.pre: Hey, hey, let me show off my bug Pokémon!
quote.defeat: I’m not going to be able to explain the charms of bug Pokémon this way!

quote.pre: What kind of person are you, to be drawn here by the scent of flowers?
quote.defeat: It was a strong Trainer who was drawn here by the scent of flowers!

quote.pre: Hey, how about you and me battle before I go into Eterna Forest?
quote.defeat: That really dampened my spirits.

quote.pre: What kinds of Pokémon live around here, I wonder?
quote.defeat: I’m shocked! How did I lose?

quote.pre: There’s no mountain here, but I’m dressed to hike! Gahaha! Here goes!
quote.defeat: Oh, yeah! A refreshing battle that was!

quote.pre: I’ve lost my way... Here of all places...
quote.defeat: Having lost his way, the Trainer lost the battle too...

quote.pre: Hiyah! There’s no holding anything back!
quote.defeat: I... I concede! I think you’re on a different level...

quote.pre: I love Pokémon that smell sweet. Like this one--get a whiff of this!
quote.defeat: Did you understand what I meant? Didn’t my Pokémon smell nice?

quote.pre: Nothing’s biting... I could use a break, I suppose.
quote.defeat: Well, that didn’t do anything for me...

quote.pre: How about that! I’ve netted me a feisty Trainer!
quote.defeat: I let a big win slip away...

quote.pre: I fished up some tough Pokémon! Let’s have ourselves a battle!
quote.defeat: Losing to a kid has me gasping like a MAGIKARP...

quote.pre: Yo! Cycling and Pokémon! Which do you prefer?
quote.defeat: Hey, not bad, you!

quote.pre: Ding-ding! Watch out, you! Or, did you want to battle?
quote.defeat: Despite all the effort, I’m just spinning my wheels... It’s always that way with me!

quote.pre: That Bike you’ve got there...it’s the type that can change gears! You gotta love that! Sure, I’ll give you a battle!
quote.defeat: Crash! Tinkle...

quote.pre: A bike will carry you a long way. The only thing that limits you is your own endurance!
quote.defeat: Gasp... Gasp... Gasp...

quote.pre: Cycling feels great! It will feel even better when I beat you in a battle!
quote.defeat: Whew! You worked us over.

quote.pre: The both of us are on Bikes, and we both have Pokémon! I can’t let you get the better of me!
quote.defeat: Oh, geez... I seem to have fallen off my Bike.

quote.pre: If you beat me, you can count on something rotten coming your way!
quote.defeat: Kerrrash!

quote.pre: Some people compete over speed, and some compete over technique. Which kind are you?
quote.defeat: You’re a speedy technician!

quote.pre: I wear shorts the whole year! I’ve got energy to burn!
quote.defeat: I couldn’t win with just energy... Nothing’s really that easy!

quote.pre: Go for it, my Pokémon! I’ll do my best, too!
quote.defeat: Oh... We lost...

quote.pre: Go do it, my Pokémon! I’ll work hard, too!
quote.defeat: Oh... We lost...

quote.pre: Wahaha! Laughter brings good fortune!
quote.defeat: Wahahaha! There’s nothing that I can do but laugh!

quote.pre: I just got through Mt. Coronet, but I’ve still got energy to burn!
quote.defeat: Whoops! Taken down easily!

quote.pre: OK, OK! Let’s be quick about this!
quote.defeat: Oh, yeah? Let’s do this again! ...Oops. I’m out of Pokémon!

quote.pre: Gahahaha! You’re just a little kid! How’re you supposed to beat a big man like me?
quote.defeat: Oh my, a big man like me got schooled by a little kid like you!

quote.pre: They call me the Echo Man! Battle with me! Yahoo!
quote.defeat: Ohh... Yo... Yodelay...

quote.pre: If I beat you, will you share some food with me?
quote.defeat: We were starved for food, and now we’re starved for a win...

quote.pre: This karate man’s going to pulverize you!
quote.defeat: We got pulverized...

quote.pre: Muhihi... I’ll haul you up and out!
quote.defeat: Restraint is my favorite word. Like...from crushing my opponents.

quote.pre: Oh, you want to have a battle? I was meaning to enter a Contest, but beating you won’t take long...
quote.defeat: Oh, you have us beaten.

quote.pre: You and I! Let us create a scene! A fantastic tableau of battle!
quote.defeat: Magnificent! I am aglow with inspiration!

quote.pre: Let me see how much you’ve raised your Pokémon.
quote.defeat: Good stuff! Your Pokémon are in impeccable condition.

quote.pre: Please, let me battle the Pokémon you’ve raised!
quote.defeat: Giggle... They’re raised with a lot of care!

quote.pre: Say, honey, where’d you come from? What kinds of Pokémon are you with?
quote.defeat: Fancy folks like you have fancy Pokémon too, it looks like.

quote.pre: I jog every morning to keep my Pokémon fit.
quote.defeat: Oops! You threw off my running rhythm.

quote.pre: Hi, hi! I’m a Pokémon!
quote.defeat: So sad... So bitter...

quote.pre: Hey, check this out! Look at the luster of my Pokémon’s fur!
quote.defeat: Hey, hey, did you take a good look?

quote.pre: I’m a rookie breeder, but I’ll do my very best!
quote.defeat: It’s all right! I’m still a rookie!

quote.pre: You seem to have a lot of confidence. Let’s see if it’s justified!
quote.defeat: Haha! A total loss for me!

quote.pre: As an Ace Trainer, I have to take battles in stride. I need to stay cool and calm whether I win or lose.
quote.defeat: Aiyeeeeh! We lost!

quote.pre: Very well. I’ve decided. I’ll battle one last time, with you, then I’m retiring as a Trainer.
quote.defeat: I’ve lost, but... What is this rush I feel?!

quote.pre: This buff physique isn’t just for show!
quote.defeat: B-but! My buff physique!

quote.pre: I just startled you! While you’re still struggling to recover, I’ll already be the winner!
quote.defeat: Oh, what’s that? You’re supposed to be fumbling more.

quote.pre: We ninjas appear where you least expect us!
quote.defeat: I didn’t expect to lose...

quote.pre: A ninja can use all kinds of skills. Like this and like that!
quote.defeat: Hmm... My ninja techniques failed to work...

quote.pre: Try not to be shocked when you lay your eyes on my Pokémon!
quote.defeat: Oh, my... Good golly ’n’ gosh...

quote.pre: I’ll teach you about the charms of bird Pokémon!
quote.defeat: Well, that was surprising!

quote.pre: Look at these beautiful wings!
quote.defeat: Oh, you! I’m going to peck you for that!

quote.pre: ZUBAT! Doesn’t that sound like a ninja bursting from cover?
quote.defeat: Oh! My ZUBAT tristars...

quote.pre: Hah! Hah! I’m psyched for this! Here goes!
quote.defeat: I don’t get why we can’t win.

quote.pre: Speed is a ninja’s best weapon! Can you keep up?
quote.defeat: I did a lot to conceal myself, too...

quote.pre: I go everywhere with my NOCTOWL. We’re gonna show you owl best! Ha!
quote.defeat: We did our best. That’s what matters. Right?

quote.pre: My Pokémon sleeps in a bed I got from overseas. I’m very well off, if you haven’t noticed!
quote.defeat: What? Over already? Well, that’s fine. Rich people like me don’t fight.

quote.pre: I’d like to begin now. Are you quite prepared?
quote.defeat: Oh! How terrible of you...

quote.pre: If it pleases you, may I challenge you to a battle?
quote.defeat: Bravo! Your technique is impeccable for someone so young.

quote.pre: I’ve never battled a young Trainer like yourself. It’s quite nerve wracking.
quote.defeat: Oh, dear... That wasn’t anything like battling with my friends.

quote.pre: Hold it right there, citizen! Walking around at night is unsafe!
quote.defeat: You’ve got tough partners with you. Carry on, citizen. Carry on.

quote.pre: I’m keeping my eyes open for crime. Anyone arousing suspicion here?
quote.defeat: Now, just hold on. I didn’t say that you were shady looking!

quote.pre: Let’s enjoy a fierce battle in the chilly night winds! Brrrr! Refreshing!
quote.defeat: I need to explain, all right? It was too dark and hard to see.

quote.pre: Can’t you see I’m fishing? Don’t talk! You’ll spook the fish!
quote.defeat: How do you like that? Both my catch and the win got away!

quote.pre: I wish some fishing-loving lady’d come along. But no, it’s all just Trainers.
quote.defeat: Sure, so I lost. But I’ll keep on fishing.

quote.pre: Water Pokémon sure get happy when it rains. So do I!
quote.defeat: Oof. Just got trampled right under your feet that time!

quote.pre: Hi, Trainer! Can you keep up with me?
quote.defeat: You’ve got energy to burn!

quote.pre: Heya, Trainer! Are you being good to Mother Nature?
quote.defeat: Good. You seem to be a kindhearted Trainer.

quote.pre: Protect the natural environment. That’s what we Rangers do!
quote.defeat: We’ve got to get tougher than this...

quote.pre: I find it reassuring to be on this damp soil...
quote.defeat: Ufufufufu... You had to beat me...

quote.pre: Whether there are problems or not, or if crimes have been committed or not, I still go out on patrol.
quote.defeat: Big trouble! Officer in need of assistance!

quote.pre: I swim the whole year round. I’m not losing a battle at sea!
quote.defeat: I lost at sea! But I swim here the whole year round!

quote.pre: Brr... I’m starting to get chilly. I could use a win to get warmed up.
quote.defeat: The chill of the sea, and the coldness of defeat... It’s a double whammy.

quote.pre: Hi, wave-riding Trainer! How about a battle on the sea?
quote.defeat: You sure schooled me there.

quote.pre: Hello, there! Aren’t you going to swim?
quote.defeat: What’s saltier? My tears or the sea...

quote.pre: Isn’t this nice? I love my inflatable tube!
quote.defeat: It’s not easy trying to move holding on to this inflatable tube.

quote.pre: Ehehe... I can battle, too!
quote.defeat: Losing made me all hungry now.

quote.pre: Traveling alone, are you? That’s impressive! How about we battle?
quote.defeat: You’re good, pip-squeak!

quote.pre: Waah! Now! Just now! I was just about to reel it in!
quote.defeat: You need to have more respect for a grown-up...

quote.pre: Ah-ha! I found me a Trainer! I challenge you to battle with the Pokémon I’ve found!
quote.defeat: It’s a challenge trying to win with Pokémon one isn’t familiar with...

quote.pre: I travel all over the world in search of mysteries.
quote.defeat: Gasp... One more... Gasp... It’s like I went on a diet...

quote.pre: I’d sensed the presence of a Trainer for a while. It was you!
quote.defeat: Defeating you will be no easy matter.

quote.pre: There! Behind you!
quote.defeat: My plan to spook you didn’t go over well at all.

quote.pre: When I toss this coin, you call it. Heads, we battle. Tails, we battle! Now, how will this play out, my friend?
quote.defeat: The coin came up tails, and like it, my Pokémon is facedown...

quote.pre: You come along with your heart pounding! You think you can win like that?! Hiyah!
quote.defeat: Gurgle...

quote.pre: Check the sharpness of my fighting Pokémon’s moves.
quote.defeat: You’ve dulled its sharpness...

quote.pre: Every drop of sweat I shed makes me that much stronger!
quote.defeat: I should be lighter by the amount of sweat I just shed!

quote.pre: Hufff-huff, huff-huff. Want-huff a battle-huff?
quote.defeat: Huff-huff, we-huff lose-huff.

quote.pre: I’m an elite battler, but cold is my nemesis!
quote.defeat: But, how...? Am I weak at battling, too?

quote.pre: I always play for keeps! This isn’t practice!
quote.defeat: Good job! That was an excellent battle.

quote.pre: I’m fully kitted up and equipped! Anytime will be fine!
quote.defeat: Hunh?!

quote.pre: To be ready to answer any call! To be ready to accept any challenge! That is the way of a Trainer!
quote.defeat: Oh, yeah? Eat snowball, punk!

quote.pre: I’m skiing right now, but OK. As we Skiers say, “Spur thing!”
quote.defeat: ...I’ve hit an ice patch!

quote.pre: Are you a novice? Or around midlevel?
quote.defeat: I never expected you to be an expert...

quote.pre: The fun things about winter! One, skiing! Two, Pokémon!
quote.defeat: Snivel...

quote.pre: How do you expect to battle in this heavy snow?
quote.defeat: The winds of victory shifted...

quote.pre: This cold is but nothing compared to the fire that burns in my heart!
quote.defeat: Your heart burns as hot as mine!

quote.pre: Wh-what is it? P-Pokémon battle?!
quote.defeat: Whew... You are alive, aren’t you?

quote.pre: I’ll show you the techniques I had drummed into me at ski school!
quote.defeat: I don’t believe it... My techniques were rebuffed...

quote.pre: We Skiers feel Mother Nature through the soles of our feet!
quote.defeat: I got a good taste of your power!

quote.pre: I’ve been skiing with Pokémon since I was just five years old.
quote.defeat: Hunh, what...? I repeat, hunh, what...?

quote.pre: Rainy days make me feel blue... But the instant it starts to snow, I’m as happy as can be!
quote.defeat: The conditions weren’t very good.

quote.pre: Poof! You’ve got a good eye spotting me!
quote.defeat: You also saw through my weak spots...

quote.pre: There are several clans of ninjas. Are you from the Iga clan? Or Kouga?
quote.defeat: I’m not much of a ninja either way...

quote.pre: I dress light wherever I go. Hiyah!
quote.defeat: Achoo!

quote.pre: Outdoor fishing for the win! Shouting doesn’t help my fishing any, but shout I must!
quote.defeat: Gwaaah! This is hurting!

quote.pre: Yeah, yeah... Nothing’s biting!
quote.defeat: Can’t catch a fish! Can’t catch a break!

quote.pre: I only live to swim. Teach me what’s so fun about Pokémon!
quote.defeat: Oh, yeah, that was fun! I learned something good!

quote.pre: On your marks, get set, go! ...When I say that, let’s start.
quote.defeat: Yow-ow-ow-ow! My leg’s cramped up!

quote.pre: OK! Get your breathing in order! OK! You’re ready to go!
quote.defeat: I let my momentum falter...

quote.pre: Swimming is a workout for your entire body. Jump in and swim! Swim, you!
quote.defeat: Sunk like a stone!

quote.pre: The human body floats more easily in the sea, so it’s easy to swim!
quote.defeat: The sea is salty, but all I taste is bitterness...

quote.pre: I may not look it now, but I’m a star. I’m always with my Pokémon.
quote.defeat: I lost, but at least I had fun.

quote.pre: Well? Does it look like I’m swimming gracefully?
quote.defeat: I’m finally feeling fatigued...

quote.pre: One thing about Water-type Pokémon: There’s a huge variety! I’ll show you the Water-type Pokémon I chose and why I’m so proud of them!
quote.defeat: I can’t boast when I lose... I’m so disappointed...

quote.pre: I like fishing, no question. But battling? That’s what I love!
quote.defeat: Sploosh!

quote.pre: They call me an Ace Trainer. Allow me to demonstrate the talent that makes me so!
quote.defeat: I’m burning with jealousy over your raw talent!

quote.pre: Really? So you think you can beat me? I’m an Ace Trainer, you do realize?
quote.defeat: I admit defeat...

quote.pre: Well, I am fishing, but... Very well! I accept your challenge!
quote.defeat: A bittersweet smile is on my lips.

quote.pre: Hi, traveler! How would you like to battle?
quote.defeat: You’ve bested this fisherman traveler.

quote.pre: I’m getting bored of fishing. Let’s have a quick battle!
quote.defeat: I’ve been done in...

quote.pre: If I stare at the water’s surface for too long, I begin to forget what I was doing in the first place.
quote.defeat: I don’t know how, but I lost!

quote.pre: My dream’s a big one! I want to battle every kind of Pokémon from around the world!
quote.defeat: I lost, but I am one step closer to realizing my dream!

quote.pre: I’ve decided! I’m off to the Pokémon League if I win!
quote.defeat: Blblblblugh...

quote.pre: It might not look like it, but I’m traveling now.
quote.defeat: You’ve got the upper hand on me.

quote.pre: The sea around these parts is harsh. As am I!
quote.defeat: The world is so harsh...

quote.pre: To swim every sea there is... That’s my dream!
quote.defeat: Boo! I’m not done with my dream!

quote.pre: Yes, I know I can surf, but I’d rather swim instead. It does seem weird, I agree.
quote.defeat: Kaploosh!

quote.pre: I train at a Pokémon Gym, too. Don’t think you’re going to win easily!
quote.defeat: Master Wake... I mean, Crasher Wake, sorry!

quote.pre: I’m determined to go to the Pokémon League, no matter how hard it is.
quote.defeat: Th-this is so hard...

quote.pre: Excuse me for wearing my bikini!
quote.defeat: Was I multitasking too much, battling and swimming at the same time?

quote.pre: Deep breathing before battle! Breathe in...and out!
quote.defeat: Breathe in...and out. Breathe in...and out!

quote.pre: Your Pokémon doesn’t seem to be tiring at all from carrying you on its back. Let me see how strong it is!
quote.defeat: I can’t take any more... I’m all tired out!

quote.pre: Did you know, I was crowned the champion of a swimsuit contest! So now, I’m trying to win a title at a Pokémon Contest!
quote.defeat: I’m speechless! I never lose when I’m in my swimsuit!

quote.pre: My favorite kind of guy is someone that looks good out on the open sea!
quote.defeat: The tide is going out...

quote.pre: Fine, all righty then. Just a quick battle on my break!
quote.defeat: Wahaha! Mercy, I cry mercy!

quote.pre: I’m gonna let you in on a secret... I snuck my Pokémon to work!
quote.defeat: Well, now aren’t you something!

quote.pre: What’s cool, you might ask? No? I’ll tell you anyway: bug Pokémon!
quote.defeat: Don’t ignore bug Pokémon! That really bugs me!

quote.pre: Here comes the swarm!
quote.defeat: Whoooh...

quote.pre: My senses tingle... I’ve spotted a rare Pokémon!
quote.defeat: Awawawawah...

quote.pre: We’re just out on a power walk!
quote.defeat: Oh, you!

quote.pre: When a Trainer and a Pokémon bond as one, a wondrous power is born...
quote.defeat: Urmmm... Urrrrmmmmm...

quote.pre: I see it... I see it... I see you going down in defeat...
quote.defeat: It is I that has gone down in defeat.

quote.pre: You... One look at you tells me you’re a real contender!
quote.defeat: You’re as tough as you look.

quote.pre: Victory Road... Somehow, it feels as if my journey is now coming to an end. But, before the final chapter is written, I must pen your defeat!
quote.defeat: That wasn’t how I planned the final chapter to go in my writing class...

quote.pre: Show me how you’ve battled to get here! Let’s do this!
quote.defeat: So, that’s how you battled...?

quote.pre: This total stranger’ll be a good way to see if I have what it takes to own the Pokémon League’s Elite Four!
quote.defeat: That battle just now must make you tougher than everyone in the world.

quote.pre: I can sense that your Pokémon have a lot of trust in you. You and your Pokémon... You seem to be aglow.
quote.defeat: Ah, I understand it now!

quote.pre: Let me see how well your Pokémon can battle!
quote.defeat: Brilliant!

quote.pre: I take Pokémon that are tough to begin with and toughen them up even more. You can help me!
quote.defeat: There’s no way I could have won!

quote.pre: This is a place where tough Trainers naturally congregate. It’s ideal for training!
quote.defeat: That’s why I like it here; I get to battle tough characters like you.

quote.pre: Aiyaah! We’re coming out swinging with super-heavy judo chops!
quote.defeat: That was... A complete trashing!

quote.pre: I keep battling so I can soar ever higher into the skies!
quote.defeat: It seems I’ve been grounded...

quote.pre: I am a Psychic! I can see your future!
quote.defeat: So be it! I will now divulge what I know of your future... Hmm!

quote.pre: I am a Psychic! I can see your past!
quote.defeat: Your past... You’ve been through a lot...

quote.pre: I’m a Veteran, yes, but don’t you dare treat me like a senior citizen!
quote.defeat: Grrr... So young, and yet so talented!

quote.pre: You avoided the long way around? Let’s see why you’d do that!
quote.defeat: Now I understand why you decided to battle with me.

quote.pre: Only those who want to win can challenge a Pokémon Gym!
quote.defeat: Gggh... This is humiliating!
W-what? That can’t be! My buffed-up Pokémon!
What’s going on here? What, I lost?!
What just happened? I lost?!
What just happened? I lost?!
Hmm! My sturdy Pokémon, defeated!

quote.pre: Up and down you go on the lifts. Me? I like to battle!
quote.defeat: You’ve got me feeling down!

quote.pre: A Pokémon Gym isn’t only about seeing how tough your Pokémon happen to be. It’s so much deeper than just that. It’s a test of you as a person.
quote.defeat: That move was devastating!

quote.pre: I can withstand this cold. That means I can take any kind of attack!
quote.defeat: Huh? It’s over, you say?

quote.pre: My Grass-type Pokémon can dole out special attacks... I won’t let you win easily!
quote.defeat: The more beautiful a flower, the faster it withers...

quote.pre: Even concealed, there is no hiding the aroma of flowers.
quote.defeat: Just like your inability to conceal your abundant skill.

I will now concede defeat. But I think you came to see how great Bug-type Pokémon can be. I hope you also realized what you’re up against in the Pokémon League. Battling is a deep and complex affair...
Well! Dear child, I must say, that was most impressive. Your Pokémon believed in you and did their best to earn you the win. Even though I’ve lost, I find myself with this silly grin!
...! I don’t believe it! I lost! I didn’t take you for granted... But I didn’t expect you to win! I’d never even considered it! I’m blown away by this! You and your Pokémon are hot stuff!
I see... You getting past the three before me was no fluke. Your power is real.

quote.pre: We Trainers will accept challenges anywhere! It’s what we do.
quote.defeat: Hmm... Insufficiently raised?

quote.pre: I’ve been to all sorts of places. That means I know tons of things!
quote.defeat: Yeah, whatever. You can battle, too...
...Just a few minutes ago, you were the most powerful challenger. And just now, you became the most powerful of all the Trainers. You are now our newest Champion!

quote.pre: ...It’s t-too cold. I can’t even feel my t-tongue.
quote.defeat: This result... ...It’s cold. Bitter cold.

quote.pre: My willpower was shaped and tempered by howling blizzards. I’ll bring it to bear on you!
quote.defeat: You weren’t even fazed...

quote.pre: Is the Gym’s trick floor making you a little hot under the collar? If you can’t maintain your cool in battle, you’ll freeze up.
quote.defeat: You were surprisingly cool... At least I have my warm boots.

quote.pre: Are you feeling all run-down? But a good Trainer is one who wins no matter the situation!
quote.defeat: That’s right. A good Trainer will win, no matter what the situation may be.

quote.pre: For the sake of my collection, I take on people I know I can’t beat. That’s what a Collector does.
quote.defeat: That attack right then was remarkable! You ought to be proud of it!

quote.pre: What’s that?! You say you have a Pokédex? An authentic one!
quote.defeat: Your Pokédex fills me with such envy, envy, envy...

quote.pre: Are you going to the Pal Park, too? For you, I’m willing to show off my prized Pokémon!
quote.defeat: So? Hot stuff, huh? That’s why I’m so proud of my Pokémon!

quote.pre: We were having a heated discussion over Pokémon the way Collectors do.
quote.defeat: Knowledge alone isn’t everything, you know...

quote.pre: I’m a Collector, and I love Honey!
quote.defeat: What’ve you done to my Pokémon?! It took me forever to catch it using Honey!

quote.pre: My dragon Pokémon chose to become powerful here. They sure like it!
quote.defeat: Your battle style... So savage...

quote.pre: I’ll take on anyone! It can only make me stronger!
quote.defeat: You won and I lost, but the both of us gained something from this.

quote.pre: An ace has the knowledge and experience of battling at high levels. I’ll demonstrate what that means to a noob like you!
quote.defeat: Wow... I’m in the mood to sing a lullaby...

quote.pre: What, were you just dawdling around hoping I’d notice you for a battle? You know you’re going to get whupped here, don’t you?
quote.defeat: I kinda deserved that, didn’t I? I gotta stop mouthing off like that...

adamantorb.name: Adamant Orb
adamantorb.description: A brightly gleaming orb to be held by DIALGA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Steel-type moves.

aguavberry.name: Aguav Berry
aguavberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but may also cause confusion.

airmail.name: Air Mail
airmail.description: Stationery featuring a print of colorful letter sets. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

amuletcoin.name: Amulet Coin
amuletcoin.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle’s prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.

apicotberry.name: Apicot Berry
apicotberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Sp. Def stat in a pinch.

armorfossil.name: Armor Fossil
armorfossil.description: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It appears to be part of a collar.

aspearberry.name: Aspear Berry
aspearberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to defrost it.

awakening.name: Awakening
awakening.description: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

azureflute.name: Azure Flute
azureflute.description: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

babiriberry.name: Babiri Berry
babiriberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Steel-type attack.

belueberry.name: Belue Berry
belueberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. Bury it in soft soil to grow a Belue Plant.

berryjuice.name: Berry Juice
berryjuice.description: A 100% pure juice made of Berries. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

bigmushroom.name: Big Mushroom
bigmushroom.description: A large and rare mushroom. It is very popular among certain maniacal fan segments.

bigpearl.name: Big Pearl
bigpearl.description: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

bigroot.name: Big Root
bigroot.description: A Pokémon hold item that boosts the power of HP-stealing moves to let the holder recover more HP.

blackbelt.name: Black Belt
blackbelt.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a belt that boosts determination and Fighting-type moves.

blackflute.name: Black Flute
blackflute.description: A black flute made from blown glass. Its melody makes wild Pokémon less likely to appear.

blacksludge.name: Black Sludge
blacksludge.description: A hold item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It inflicts damage on all other types.

blackglasses.name: BlackGlasses
blackglasses.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a shady-looking pair of glasses that boosts Dark-type moves.

bloommail.name: Bloom Mail
bloommail.description: Stationery featuring a print of pretty floral patterns. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

blueflute.name: Blue Flute
blueflute.description: A blue flute made from blown glass. Its melody awakens a single Pokémon from sleep.

bluescarf.name: Blue Scarf

blueshard.name: Blue Shard

blukberry.name: Bluk Berry

bubblemail.name: Bubble Mail

burnheal.name: Burn Heal

calcium.name: Calcium

repel.description: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps after its use.

revivalherb.name: Revival Herb
revivalherb.description: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, fully restoring its HP.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon’s maximum HP.

rindoberry.name: Rindo Berry
rindoberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Grass-type attack.

rockincense.name: Rock Incense
rockincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

rootfossil.name: Root Fossil
rootfossil.description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a plant root.

roseincense.name: Rose Incense
roseincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

rowapberry.name: Rowap Berry
rowapberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, and if a foe’s special attack lands, the foe also takes damage.

rulebook.name: Rule Book
rulebook.description: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

ssticket.name: S.S. Ticket
ssticket.description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

sacredash.name: Sacred Ash
sacredash.description: It revives all fainted Pokémon. In doing so, it also fully restores their HP.

safariball.name: Safari Ball
safariball.description: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Great Marsh. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

salacberry.name: Salac Berry
salacberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Speed stat in a pinch.

scopelens.name: Scope Lens
scopelens.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a lens that boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

seaincense.name: Sea Incense
seaincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

sealbag.name: Seal Bag
sealbag.description: A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

sealcase.name: Seal Case
sealcase.description: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the capsule cases of Poké Balls.

secretkey.name: Secret Key
secretkey.description: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.

secretpotion.name: SecretPotion
secretpotion.description: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

sharpbeak.name: Sharp Beak
sharpbeak.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

shedshell.name: Shed Shell
shedshell.description: A tough, discarded carapace to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

shellbell.name: Shell Bell
shellbell.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is restored a little every time it inflicts damage.

shinystone.name: Shiny Stone
shinystone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

shoalsalt.name: Shoal Salt
shoalsalt.description: Pure salt that was discovered deep inside the Shoal Cave. It is extremely salty.

shoalshell.name: Shoal Shell
shoalshell.description: A pretty seashell that was found deep inside the Shoal Cave. It is striped in blue and white.

shucaberry.name: Shuca Berry
shucaberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Ground-type attack.

silkscarf.name: Silk Scarf
silkscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

silverpowder.name: SilverPowder
silverpowder.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a shiny, silver powder that ups the power of Bug-type moves.

sitrusberry.name: Sitrus Berry
sitrusberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to heal the user’s HP a little.

skullfossil.name: Skull Fossil
skullfossil.description: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It appears to be part of a head.

skyplate.name: Sky Plate
skyplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

smokeball.name: Smoke Ball
smokeball.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to flee from any wild Pokémon without fail.

smoothrock.name: Smooth Rock
smoothrock.description: A Pokémon hold item that extends the duration of the move Sandstorm used by the holder.

snowmail.name: Snow Mail
snowmail.description: Stationery featuring a print of a chilly, snow-covered world. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

sodapop.name: Soda Pop
sodapop.description: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

softsand.name: Soft Sand
softsand.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

soothebell.name: Soothe Bell
soothebell.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bell with a comforting chime that calms the holder and makes it friendly.

souldew.name: Soul Dew
souldew.description: A wondrous orb to be held by LATIOS or LATIAS. It raises both the Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

spacemail.name: Space Mail
spacemail.description: Stationery featuring a print depicting the huge expanse of space. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

spelltag.name: Spell Tag
spelltag.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

spelonberry.name: Spelon Berry
spelonberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. Bury it in soft soil to grow a Spelon Plant.

splashplate.name: Splash Plate
splashplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

spookyplate.name: Spooky Plate
spookyplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

sprayduck.name: Sprayduck
sprayduck.description: A watering can shaped like a PSYDUCK. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

stablemulch.name: Stable Mulch
stablemulch.description: A plant fertilizer spread on soft soil. It extends the time ripened Berries remain on their plants before falling.

starpiece.name: Star Piece
starpiece.description: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

stardust.name: Stardust
stardust.description: Lovely, red-colored sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

starfberry.name: Starf Berry
starfberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it sharply raises one of its stats in a pinch.

steelmail.name: Steel Mail
steelmail.description: Stationery featuring a print of cool mechanical designs. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

stick.name: Stick
stick.description: An item to be held by FARFETCH’D. It is a very long and stiff stalk of leek that boosts the critical-hit ratio.

stickybarb.name: Sticky Barb
stickybarb.description: A hold item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to foes that touch the holder.

stoneplate.name: Stone Plate
stoneplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

storagekey.name: Storage Key
storagekey.description: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

suitekey.name: Suite Key
suitekey.description: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

sunstone.name: Sun Stone
sunstone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.

superpotion.name: Super Potion
superpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

superrepel.name: Super Repel
superrepel.description: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps after its use.

superrod.name: Super Rod
superrod.description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

tamatoberry.name: Tamato Berry
tamatoberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Speed stat.

tangaberry.name: Tanga Berry
tangaberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Bug-type attack.

thickclub.name: Thick Club
thickclub.description: An item to be held by CUBONE or MAROWAK. It is a hard bone of some sort that boosts the Attack stat.

thunderstone.name: Thunderstone
thunderstone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

timerball.name: Timer Ball
timerball.description: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

tinymushroom.name: TinyMushroom
tinymushroom.description: A small and rare mushroom. It is quite popular among certain maniacal fan segments.

tm01.name: TM01
tm01.description: The user focuses its mind before launching this attack. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

tm02.name: TM02
tm02.description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

tm03.name: TM03
tm03.description: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

tm04.name: TM04
tm04.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tm05.name: TM05
tm05.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tm06.name: TM06
tm06.description: A move that leaves the foe badly poisoned. This poison damage worsens every turn.

tm07.name: TM07
tm07.description: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except Ice.

tm08.name: TM08
tm08.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

tm09.name: TM09
tm09.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

tm10.name: TM10
tm10.description: A variable move that changes type and power depending on the hidden ability of the Pokémon using it.

tm11.name: TM11
tm11.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tm12.name: TM12
tm12.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

tm13.name: TM13
tm13.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tm14.name: TM14
tm14.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

tm15.name: TM15
tm15.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tm16.name: TM16
tm16.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

tm17.name: TM17
tm17.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm18.name: TM18
tm18.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

tm19.name: TM19
tm19.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm20.name: TM20
tm20.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems like poison, paralysis, burn, and sleep.

tm21.name: TM21
tm21.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tm22.name: TM22
tm22.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

tm23.name: TM23
tm23.description: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat if it hits.

tm24.name: TM24
tm24.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

tm25.name: TM25
tm25.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

tm26.name: TM26
tm26.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tm27.name: TM27
tm27.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tm28.name: TM28
tm28.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tm29.name: TM29
tm29.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tm30.name: TM30
tm30.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tm31.name: TM31
tm31.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

tm32.name: TM32
tm32.description: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

tm33.name: TM33
tm33.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tm34.name: TM34
tm34.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

tm35.name: TM35
tm35.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

tm36.name: TM36
tm36.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.

tm37.name: TM37
tm37.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

tm38.name: TM38
tm38.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

tm39.name: TM39
tm39.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It lowers the foe’s Speed.

tm40.name: TM40
tm40.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then strikes. The attack lands without fail.

tm41.name: TM41
tm41.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tm42.name: TM42
tm42.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tm43.name: TM43
tm43.description: An attack move with effects that vary depending on the user’s environment.

tm44.name: TM44
tm44.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tm45.name: TM45
tm45.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tm46.name: TM46
tm46.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

tm47.name: TM47
tm47.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

tm48.name: TM48
tm48.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

tm49.name: TM49
tm49.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or status-changing move the foe attempts to use.

tm50.name: TM50
tm50.description: The user attacks the foe at full power using fiery energy. It also sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk.

tm51.name: TM51
tm51.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

tm52.name: TM52
tm52.description: The user attacks at full power. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat if it hits.

tm53.name: TM53
tm53.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tm54.name: TM54
tm54.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

tm55.name: TM55
tm55.description: If the foe’s HP is down to under half, this attack will hit with double the power.

tm56.name: TM56
tm56.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

tm57.name: TM57
tm57.description: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

tm58.name: TM58
tm58.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm59.name: TM59
tm59.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

tm60.name: TM60
tm60.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm61.name: TM61
tm61.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

tm62.name: TM62
tm62.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

tm63.name: TM63
tm63.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

tm64.name: TM64
tm64.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

tm65.name: TM65
tm65.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tm66.name: TM66
tm66.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the foe, its power is doubled.

tm67.name: TM67
tm67.description: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

tm68.name: TM68
tm68.description: The user charges the foe using every bit of its power. It must rest on the next turn to recover.

tm69.name: TM69
tm69.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.

tm70.name: TM70
tm70.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

tm71.name: TM71
tm71.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tm72.name: TM72
tm72.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

tm73.name: TM73
tm73.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

tm74.name: TM74
tm74.description: The user tackles the foe from a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

tm75.name: TM75
tm75.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tm76.name: TM76
tm76.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

tm77.name: TM77
tm77.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

tm78.name: TM78
tm78.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tm79.name: TM79
tm79.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

tm80.name: TM80
tm80.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tm81.name: TM81
tm81.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tm82.name: TM82
tm82.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tm83.name: TM83
tm83.description: The user draws power from the Berry it is holding to attack. The Berry determines its type and power.

tm84.name: TM84
tm84.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the foe.

tm85.name: TM85
tm85.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

tm86.name: TM86
tm86.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

tm87.name: TM87
tm87.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tm88.name: TM88
tm88.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

tm89.name: TM89
tm89.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tm90.name: TM90
tm90.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tm91.name: TM91
tm91.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it in one shot. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tm92.name: TM92
tm92.description: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

townmap.name: Town Map
townmap.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

toxicorb.name: Toxic Orb
toxicorb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.

toxicplate.name: Toxic Plate
toxicplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

tunnelmail.name: Tunnel Mail
tunnelmail.description: Stationery featuring a print of a dimly lit coal mine. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

twistedspoon.name: TwistedSpoon
twistedspoon.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a spoon imbued with telekinetic power that boosts Psychic-type moves.

ultraball.name: Ultra Ball
ultraball.description: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

upgrade.name: Up-Grade
upgrade.description: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.

vsrecorder.name: Vs. Recorder
vsrecorder.description: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.

vsseeker.name: Vs. Seeker
vsseeker.description: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

wacanberry.name: Wacan Berry
wacanberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Electric-type attack.

waterstone.name: Water Stone
waterstone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

watmelberry.name: Watmel Berry
watmelberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. Bury it in soft soil to grow a Watmel Plant.

waveincense.name: Wave Incense
waveincense.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

wepearberry.name: Wepear Berry
wepearberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. Bury it in soft soil to grow a Wepear Plant.

whiteflute.name: White Flute
whiteflute.description: A white flute made from blown glass. Its melody makes wild Pokémon more likely to appear.

whiteherb.name: White Herb
whiteherb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

widelens.name: Wide Lens
widelens.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

wikiberry.name: Wiki Berry
wikiberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but may also cause confusion.

wiseglasses.name: Wise Glasses
wiseglasses.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a thick pair of glasses that slightly boosts the power of special moves.

workskey.name: Works Key
workskey.description: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

xaccuracy.name: X Accuracy
xaccuracy.description: An item that raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

xattack.name: X Attack
xattack.description: An item that raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

xdefense.name: X Defend
xdefense.description: An item that raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

xspdef.name: X Sp. Def
xspdef.description: An item that raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

xspecial.name: X Special
xspecial.description: An item that raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

xspeed.name: X Speed
xspeed.description: An item that raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

yacheberry.name: Yache Berry
yacheberry.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Ice-type attack.

yellowflute.name: Yellow Flute
yellowflute.description: A yellow flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pokémon out of confusion.

yellowscarf.name: Yellow Scarf
yellowscarf.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Tough” aspect of the holder in a Contest.

yellowshard.name: Yellow Shard
yellowshard.description: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

zapplate.name: Zap Plate
zapplate.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

zinc.name: Zinc
zinc.description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Def (Special Defense) stat of a single Pokémon.

zoomlens.name: Zoom Lens
zoomlens.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after the foe, its accuracy will be boosted.
